tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /kyai rdo rje'i bskyed rim kyi bshad pa bzhugs/

na mo gu ru we/ rnam kun mchog dang ldan pa'i ye shes dang*/ /dpal ldan 'gyur ba med pa'i bde ba che/ /zung 'jug 'khor lo'i mgon po bla ma la/ / mchog tu gus pa chen pos phyag 'tshal lo/ /de yi go 'phang sgrub byed bdud rtsi'i bcud/ /grub brnyes brgyud pa'i lam las 'ongs pa 'di/ /brjed nges rtog pa spang phyir legs bshad kyi/ /chu dwangs nor bu'i 'phreng ba spel bar bya/ / 'dir brgyud kyi rgyal po dpal kyai rdo rje las brtsams te rim gnyis kyi rnam par gzhag pa 'chad pa la gnyis te/ rgyud kyi mngon par rtogs pa mdo tsam bstan pa dang*/ rim pa gnyis bye brag tu bshad pa'o/ /dang po la/ rjod byed tshig gi rgyud rnam par gzhag pa dang*/ brjod bya don gyi rgyud nges par bya ba'o/ / dang po la/ rgyud 'di nyid rgyud sde gang du gtogs pa dang*/ gsungs pa po'i ston pa gang yin pa dang*/ rgyud nyid du ngos bzung ba'o/ / dang po ni bdag cag gi ston pas dam pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo bsam gyis mi khyab pa bskor ba thams cad theg pa dman pa'i sde snod dang*/ theg chen gyi sde snod gnyis su 'dus la/ theg chen gyi sde snod kyang rgyu pha rol tu phyin pa'i sde snod dang*/ 'bras bu rdo rje theg pa'i sde snod gnyis su 'dus/ gnyis pa rdo rje theg pa'i sde snod thams cad kyang rgyud sde bzhir 'dus te/ rdo rje gur las/ dman pa rnams la bya ba'i rgyud/ /bya min rnal 'byor de lhag la/ /sems can mchog la rnal 'byor mchog /rnal 'byor bla med de lhag pa'o/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar rgyud sde bzhi las 'di rnal 'byor bla na med pa'i rgyud do/ /de la yang thabs kyi rgyud dang*/ shes rab kyi rgyud dang*/ thabs shes gnyis su med pa'i rgyud gsum las/ 'di thabs shes gnyis su med pa'i rgyud yin te/ 'di nyid las/ he ni snying rje chen po nyid/ /badz+ra'ang shes rab brjod par bya/

/shes rab thabs kyi bdag nyid rgyud/ /de ni nga yis bshad kyis nyon/ /zhes gsungs so/ / gnyis med rgyud de'i yang snying por gyur pa kyai rdo rje'i rgyud do/ / gnyis pa ni/ spyir rgyud sde thams cad rdo rje 'chang chen pos gsungs shing*/ khyad par du rgyud 'di nyid thog ma med pa'i dus nas ston pa he ru ka'i rnam pas dag pa'i 'khor tshogs rgya mtsho las gsungs pa/ bar skabs bar skabs su nub par gyur pa las/ bdag cag gi ston pa mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas pa'i tshul bstan pa'i tshe 'og min du longs sku zhal brgyad phyag bcu drug pa dang*/ 'dzam bu'i gling du sprul sku zhal brgyad phyag bcu drug pa'i rnam pas gsungs so/ / gsum pa ni/ kyai rdo rje'i rgyud rgyas pa 'bum phrag lnga pa zhig yod do/ /rdo rje gur las/ 'bum phrag lnga bdag kyai rdo rje/ /lus ni dkyil 'khor lnga gsungs pa/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ rdo rje rigs kyi dum bu/ sngags kyi dum bu/ dbang bskur ba'i dum bu/ lha'i dum bu/ de kho na nyid kyi dum bu ste de re re la/ sh+lo ka 'bum phrag re re ste 'bum phrag lnga'o/ /de las bsdus pa'i rgyud la/ rtsa ba'i rgyud/ bshad pa'i rgyud/ cha mthun gyi rgyud gsum las/ dang po ni rtsa ba'i rgyud brtag pa gnyis pa yin la/ /gnyis pa thun mong ma yin pa'i bshad rgyud rdo rje gur/ thun mong ba'i bshad rgyud sam+bhu ṭi'o/ / gsum pa ni/ phyag chen thig le/ ye shes thig le/ ye shes snying po/ rnal 'byor ma thams cad gsang ba sgron me'i rgyud de thig le skor bzhi/ rdo rje a ra li dang*/ ri ṣi a ra li dang*/ rnyog pa med pa'i rgyud rnams so/ /de yang rtsa ba'i rgyud brtag pa gnyis pa 'di rgyud rgyas pa brtag pa sum cu rtsa gnyis pa las byung ba yin cing*/ de la 'dod tshul mi 'dra ba du ma byung na'ang brtag pa phyi ma gnyis phyung bar bla ma gong ma rnams kyis bzhed do/

/'di la 'grel bshad tshad ldan mang du byung mod/ 'phags yul du shing rta'i srol 'byed tha dad du grags pa ni med la/ bod yul 'dir lugs srol mang du byung ba las/ dpal ldan sa skya ba yab sras la bka' babs pa ni/ slob dpon mthu stobs kyi dbang phyug bir+wa pa'i man ngag gi lugs dang*/ grub chen ḍom bhi he ru ka rjes 'brang dang bcas pa'i lugs dang*/ slob dpon mtsho skyes kyi lugs dang*/ nag po dam tshig rdo rje'i lugs de bka' bab bzhir grags pa dang*/ gzhan yang nā ro pa dang*/ mai+e tri pa'i lugs te drug go / de la dang po ni snyan rgyud gtso zhing*/ skabs 'dir gtan la dbab bya'i gtso bo yin la/ ḍom+bhi lugs sogs phyi ma gsum la ni/ ji skad du/ snying po'i don gyi kyai rdor ni/ /bir+wa'i rjes 'brang ḍom+bhi'i skor/ /yan lag med rjes pad+ma'i skor/ /dam tshig rdo rje nag po'i skor/ /gtso che'i chos sna sum cu dgu /zhes pa ltar gtso che ba'i chos sna sum cu rtsa dgu yod cing*/ nā ro pa yi lugs pham thing nas brgyud/ mal lo tsā ba la skya pa chen po'i gsan cing*/ mai tri pa'i lugs la bsgrub thabs dang yid la mi byed pa'i chos skor nyi shu rtsa drug bzhugs so/ /shan+ti me tri snyan grags bzang*/ /zhes gsungs pa'i shan ti pa'i lugs ni nag po lugs su 'dus so/ /de rnams las slob dpon bir+wa pa'i lugs 'di rje btsun gong mas mdzad pa rags rim smos na/ bshad pa la nye bar mkho ba'i gzhung bdun te/ rgyud sde'i dum bu/ rgyud de'i spyi rnam/ rgyud kyi mngon rtogs/ de gnyis kyi bsdus don stong thun/ yab kyi bstod pa/ yum gyi bstod pa/ bdag med bstod 'grel lo/ / ji skad du/ rgyud sde'i dum bu rnam bzhag mngon rtogs dang*/ /stong thun gnyis kyi bsdus don bstod pa gnyis/ /bdag med bstod pa'i rnam 'grel dang bcas pa/ /kun tu dgos pa'i gzhung bdun 'thor mi bya/

/zhes gsungs so/ / gzhung bdun po'i steng du/ rgyud gsum la 'grel pa gsum/ bsdus don gsum te drug bsnan pas bshad pa spyi 'gros chos bcu gsum ste/ ji skad du/ rgyud don so so'i rnam 'grel dang bcas pa/ /gang la gang dgos de de blang bya ste/ /de ltar bcu gsum legs par rab bltas na/ /rnam par phye ba'i rgyud gsum shes par 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs so/ /spyir lag tu blang ba'i chos bcu bzhi ni/ ji skad du/ smin byed ltung ba'i rnam bshad sgrub thabs bzhi/ /rab gnas sbyin sreg tshogs kyi cho gar bcas/ /rdo rje dril bu bgrang phreng dgang blugs dang*/ /tha ma'i cho ga mchod rten sgrub pa ste/ /de ltar bcu bzhi dang po'i lus can nas/ / brtsams te gang zag kun gyis gzung bar bya/ /zhes so/ /de yang dbang bcu/ rtsa ltung 'khrul spong*/ mngon rtog rgyas pa yan lag bzhi pa/ 'bring po yan lag drug pa/ bsdus pa lhan skyes/ yum gyi sgrub thabs dang bzhi/ 'ga' zhig mngon rtogs bsdus pa med/ mtsho skyes lugs kyi mngon rtogs tshigs bcad ma 'dren zer te ha cang thal bar 'dra'o/ /bsdus pa'ang da lta bka' 'bum na bzhugs pa 'di yin pa'i nges pa med/ yin na yig sna drug ci'i las dang po'i chos kyi nang du 'dren rig pa las ma bgrangs/ des na kyai rdor gyi sgrub thabs yin pa'i nges pa med pas man ngag lugs kyi rgyud 'chad pa la mkho ba'i sgrub thabs gzhan yod pa deng sang dpe ma rnyed pa'ang yin srid gsungs so/ /rab gnas bzang po dang drug sbyin bsreg zhi ba dang las bzhi/ rdo rje dang dril bu'i de nyid dus tha ma'i cho ga rnams la yig cha re re yod cing*/ bgrang phreng dgang blugs mchod rten sgrub pa rnams la yig cha zur dang lnga par yod pa dang deng sang nub pa'i/ yang na yig cha che ba rnams kyi nang na cha shas kyi gsungs pa rnams la dgongs zer ro/ / zhar la 'ongs pa sbas pa'i brtul zhugs la nye bar mkho ba'i chos drug ni/

ji skad du/ rus rgyan btags pa'i snod dang gzung bya'i zas/ /rol mo'i cho ga stan dang bgo ba'i gos/ /'di dag he ru ka dpal chas drug ste/ /rnam par phye na bcu bzhir 'gro ba yin/ /zhes so/ /bcu bzhi po gang zhe na/ rgyan la bzhi dang*/ btung ba'i snod dang lnga/ lag cha gnyis dang rol mo'i cha byad gsum/ stan dang gos la gnyis gnyis te/ de ltar bdun du dbye ba'i rnam grangs bcu bzhi'o/ / zhes gsungs pa'i rgyan bzhi ni/ rus rgyan/ khrag gi thig le/ zhag gi zo ris/ thal chen gyi tshom bu rnams so/ /btung ba'i snod thod pa/ lag cha gnyis ni gri gug dang kha ṭ+waṃ ga'o/ /rol mo'i cha byad gsum ni/ cang te'u/ gsang ba'i rnge'u chung*/ mi rkang gi gling bu rnams so/ /stan gnyis ni/ stag lpags dang ro gdan no/ /gos gnyis ni stag lpags dang*/ ro'i chas gos so/ /gzhan yang gdan gyi rnam grangs sogs mang du yod cing*/ sbas pa'i don rnams gsung rab rin po che las 'phros nas dkar chag sogs su mdzad do/ / gnyis pa brjod bya don gyi rgyud nges par bya ba ni/ /ji skad du/ gsang ba 'dus pa'i rgyud phyi ma las/ rgyud ni rgyun chags zhes bya ste/ /rgyud de rnam pa gsum du 'gyur/ /gzhi dang de yi rang bzhin dang*/ /mi phrogs pa yi rab dbye ba/ /rang bzhin rnam pa rgyu yin te/ /gzhi ni thabs shes bya ba yin/ /de bzhin mi phrogs 'bras bu'o/ /gsum gyis rgyud kyi don bsdus pa'o/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ brjod bya don gyi rgyud la dbye na/ rgyu rgyud sngon du 'gro ba rten gyi gang zaganyams su blang bya thabs kyi rgyud/ nyams su blangs pas thob pa 'bras bu'i rgyud dang gsum mo/ /dang po la/ rgyu rgyud kyi ngo bo/ gang zag gi rang bzhin/ de'i rgyud ji ltar sbyangs pa'i tshul dang gsum/ dang po ni/ sems rang bzhin gyis 'od gsal ba kun tu 'gro ba de yin la/ de'i snang cha 'khor ba'i chos thams cad kyang rgyu rgyud du bsdus pa yin te/

rdo rje rtse mo las/ rgyud ni rgyun zhes bya ba ste/ /'khor ba rgyud du 'dod pa yin/ /zhes so/ /gnyis pa gang zag gi rang bzhin ni/ slob dpon gar+bha ri pas/ rgyu rigs spang bya rkyen la ltos/ /gang zag rnam pa bzhi yin no/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ gang zag la dbye na/ rgyu la ltos pa/ rigs la ltos pa/ spang bya la ltos pa/ rkyen la ltos pa dang bzhi'o/ /gsum pa ni/ spyod pa'i tshul khrims kyi rim pas sbyang ba/ lta ba'i rim pas sbyang ba dbang gis smin par byed pa ste/ ji skad du/ skal dman sems can 'dul dka' ba/ /gang gis 'dul bar 'gyur ba lags/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ /dang por gso sbyong sbyin par bya/ /de rjes bslab pa'i gnas bcu nyid/ /de la bye brag smra ba bstan/ /mdo sde pa yang de bzhin no/ /rnal 'byor spyod pa de la phyes/ /de yi rjes su dbu ma bstan/ /theg pa'i rim pa kun shes nas/ /de rjes kyai rdo rje bstan/ /ces gsungs so/ /de yang skal dman rim 'jug pa'i dbang du byas pa yin la/ skal ldan cig car ba la ni dbang bskur ba kho nas rgyud sbyang ba 'grub pa yin no/ / spyir dbang la/ rgyu dus kyi dbang*/ lam dus kyi dbang/ 'bras dus kyi dbang gsum yod/ /de gsum ngo bo'i sgo nas thabs rgyud yin kyang*/ ma smin pa smin par byed pa'i dbang ngam/ rgyu dus kyi dbang ni/ rang gang la bskur ba'i sems rgyud de rgyu rgyud khyad par can du byed pa'i phyir rgyu rgyud kyi mngon rtogs yin no/ /ji skad du/ thabs la smin byed dbang dang nyams myong dang*/ /zhes thabs rgyud du gsungs pa'ang yod/ de la gang du dbang bskur ba'i dkyil 'khor/ gang la dbang bskur ba/ ji ltar bskur ba'i tshul dang gsum/ dang po ni/ sam+bhu ṭi las/ dkyil 'khor lus su gsungs pa ste/ /dkyil 'khor bha ga zhes su brjod/ /dkyil 'khor byang chub sems yin te/ /dkyil 'khor gsum du gsungs pa'o/

/zhes gsungs pa ltar/ bum dbang gi dkyil 'khor lus kyi dkyil 'khor dang*/ rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor dang/ dbyibs su bkod pa'i dkyil 'khor gzhan dang*/ ting nge 'dzin gyi dkyil 'khor te bzhi yod pa las/ 'dir gtso bor gyur pa lus kyi dkyil 'khor smos shing*/ bha ga'i dkyil 'khor du gsang dbang*/ byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor la gnyis las/ kun rdzob byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor du shes rab ye shes kyi dbang dang*/ don dam byang chub sems kyis dkyil 'khor du dbang bzhi pa bskur ba yin no/ /gang zag rab 'bring tha ma gsum kha la spyir btang la smin byed kyi bum dbang rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur dgos shing*/ ras bris dang*/ rdo rje dril bu pas smin byed lus dkyil du bskur bar gsungs pa sogs dmigs bsal yin no/ / gnyis pa ni/ slob ma'i lus rtsa'i dkyil 'khor la bum dbang*/ rtsa ba'i yi ge dkyil 'khor la gsang dbang*/ khams bdud rtsi'i dkyil 'khor la shes rab ye shes kyi dbang*/ snying po ye shes rlung gi dkyil 'khor la dbang bzhi pa bskur ba yin/ gsum pa ni/ mngon par rtogs pa bdun dang ldan ste/ de yang sngon du 'gro ba bsnyen pa ni slob dpon gyis bsgrub par bya ba yin zhing dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga la dngos la slob ma rjes bzung*/ sa chog brtag bslang sbyang bzung srung ba sta gon rnam pa bzhi'i rim pa/ dris shing rgyan bkram pa/ sgrub cing mchod/ bdag nyid 'jug cing dbang blang ba/ slob ma gzhug cing dbang bskur ba'o/ / rjes chog ni slar bsdu ba'i cho ga'o/ /gnyis pa thabs rgyud kyi mngon par rtog pa bcu gcig ste/ mchog sgrub pa'i mngon rtogs lnga/ thun mong sgrub pa'i mngon rtogs lnga/ gnyis ka la dgos pa'i grogs dam tshig dang sdom pa'o/ / dang po lnga ni las thams cad lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes su shes par bya ba'i phyir rtogs pa'i lta ba dang*/

rdzogs rim gyi brten bskyed pa'i rim pa/ lhar snang ye shes su rtogs par bya ba'i rdzogs pa'i rim pa/ rim gnyis brten nas bogs 'byin pa spyod pa/ 'bras bu la mtshams sbyor ba nye rgyu ā li kā li byang chub kyi sems rnams so/ / gnyis pa lnga ni/ yi dam lha'i thugs brgyud bskul ba'i phyir bzlas pa/ bar chad la sogs pa zhi bar bya ba'i phyir gtor ma/ sku gzugs byin gyis brlabs pa'i phyir rab gnas/ las thams cad 'grub par bya ba'i phyir sbyin sreg /dman pa la mos pa'i gang zag rjes su bzung ba'i phyir las rab 'byams rnams so/ /de gnyis kyi dang po/ lta ba la thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i lta ba gnyis las/ dang po ni pha rol tu phyin pa'i lta ba yin la/ de'i thos bsam gyi lta ba ni lta ba dug can du bzhed do/ / gnyis pa thun mong ma yin pa sngags kyi lta ba ni/ spros pa thams cad dang bral ba'i stong nyid de yul can dbang gi ye shes kyis myong bar byas pa la ngos 'dzin pa yin no/ /rim pa gnyis kyi rnam bzhag 'og tu 'chad la/ spyod pa de la a wa dhu ti kun 'dar gyi spyod pa/ kun tu bzang po'i spyod pa/ phyogs las rnams rgyal gyi spyod pa ste gsum mo/ /nye rgyu ni spyod pa dang 'brel ba yin mod/ thun mong min pa'i khyad par ni/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas sprul pa'i sku dang*/ longs spyod rdzogs pa'i skus dbang bskur ba 'bras dus kyi dbang gi ye shes dang 'brel ba yin no/ /bzlas pa la sogs pa thun mong gi mngon par rtogs pa lnga ni gzhan du 'chad do/ /gsum pa dam tshig dang sdom pa la dbye na las dang po'i dam tshig

/brtan pa cung zad thob pa'i dam tshig brtan pa cher thob pa'i dam tshig ste gsum mo/ /man ngag las ni dbang bzhi po re re la mnyam bzhag gi dam tshig /rjes spyod kyi dam tshig /bsrungs pa'i dam tshig /bza' ba'i dam tshig /mi bral ba'i dam tshig ste lnga lngar phye nas dam tshig nyi shu rtsa lngar bshad/ de las spyod pa dang nye rgyu ni rdzogs rim gyi yan lag yin la/ mngon par rtogs pa thun mong ba lnga ni bskyed rim gyi yan lag rtogs pa'i lta ba dang dam tshig ni gnyis ka la dgos pa yin no/ / des na thabs rgyud kyi mngon par rtogs pa bcu gcig la rtsa ba gnyis dang yan lag dgu'o/ /gsum pa nyams su blangs bas thob pa 'bras bus rgyud la/ gnas skabs kyi 'bras bu sa bcu gnyis dang*/ mthar thug g-i 'bras bu sangs rgyas kyi sa'o/ /dang po la/ ngo bo ni bde stong gi ye shes yin la/ de'i rgyu ni/ phyi rol du yul chen po rnams bsgrod pa dang*/ nang du rtsa rlung thig le'i bgrod dbu mar thim pa yin no/ /'di'i nyams su blang bya mnyam bzhag tu bde ba chen po'i ye shes sgom pa dang*/ rjes thob tu rig pa brtul zhugs kyi spyod pa'o/ /sa rnams kyi yon tan la/ thun mong ba dang mdo dang mtshungs shing*/ thun mong ma yin pa'i yon tan ni rgyas par rgyud du shes par bya'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ sku bzhi dang ye shes lngas bsdus pa yin zhing*/ gzhan yang sangs rgyas kyi sku dang gsung thugs kyi gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang*/ yon tan dang 'phrin las kyi 'jug pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa la sogs pa rgyud du shes par bya'o/ / gnyis pa rim pa gnyis bye brag tu bshad pa la/ rim gnyis spyi'i rnam bzhag bstan pa dang*/ bskyed rim rgyas par bshad pa'o/ /dang po la/ ngo bo/ dbye ba/ sgra don/ grangs nges/ go rim/ grol ba'i 'thad pa te rim gnyis spyi'i mngon rtogs drug go /dang po ngo bo ni/ yid mtshan rtog las skyob pa'i thabs khyad par can te/

bde stong gi ye shes lha sku'i rnam pa dang 'brel ba'o/ /gnyis par dbye ba la/ bskyed rim dang*/ rdzogs rim gnyis/ dang po la dbye na/ ting nge 'dzin gsum/ yan lag bzhi/ yan lag drug pa rnams su yod/ gnyis pa rdzogs rim la/ rang byin rlabs dang*/ dkyil 'khor 'khor lo gnyis su yod/ gsum pa sgra don ni/ 'phags skor ba'i lugs la sbyang gzhi las ming du btags par bzhed do/ /tha mal gyi lus grub pa ni bskyed pa/ skye gnas bzhi dang*/ bye brag mngal skyes kyi sgo nas skye ba'i rim pa/ tha mal gyi sems can 'chi ba rdzogs pa/ sa chu la thim pa sogs rim pa sbyong byed lha'i rnal 'byor dang rdor bzlas 'od gsal la sogs pa la de skad brtags par bzhed do/ /spyod bsdus las/ gang zhig skye ba kun rdzob bden pa ste/ /'chi ba'i ming yang don dam bden pa'o/ /rim gnyis 'di dag bla ma'i drin gyis ni/ /rnyed pa 'di dag ma 'ongs sangs rgyas yin/ /zhes gsungs/ dus 'khor ba rnams 'bras bu'i sgo nas ming du btags par bzhed de/ bskyed pa'i don thun mong gi dngos grub/ rdzogs pa'i don mchog gi dngos grub/ rim pa ni de gnyis mngon du byed pa'i lam ste/ lha sku sgom pa dang rnal 'byor yan lag drug sgom pa'o/ /slob dpon rnal 'byor dbang phyug bir+wa pa rjes 'brang dang bcas pa'i dgongs don rang lugs ni/ bskyed pa'i don yid rnam rtog gi rtsol bas bskyed pa'i lha sku dang*/ rdzogs pa ni lus ngag yid gsum rdzogs pa ste/ de'i don yang lus rtsa/ ngag rlung dang yi ge /sems thig le rnams lus la ji ltar gnas pa bzhin du rdzogs par sgom pa yin pas/ gzhan du yongs su grub pa'i rim pa zhes bya ba dang mthun pa yin no/ / bzhi pa grangs nges ni/ spang bya gnyis su nges pa'i phyir dang*/ thob bya gnyis su nges pa'i phyir dang*/ ngo bo rten dang brten pa yin pa'i phyir/ bskyed rdzogs gnyis su grangs nges so/

/dang po ni/ tha mal gyi rnam rtog gzhom pa'i phyir bskyed pa'i rim pa dang*/ gya nom lhar zhen gyi rnam rtog gzhom pa'i phyir rdzogs pa'i rim pa sgom dgos pa yin te/ rdo rje gur las/ tha mal rnam rtog gzhom pa'i phyir/ /sgom pa yang dag rab tu bsgrags/ /rang bzhin gnas skabs bsgom pa ni/ /sgom pa ma yin mi bsgoms min/ /zhes gsungs/ tha mal gyi rnam rtog de la dbye na/ rgyu las dang nyon mongs pa dang*/ 'bras bu bdag dang bdag gir 'dzin pa gnyis las/ dang po ni tshogs bsags pa rnam pa gnyis kyis sbyor bar byed cing*/ gnyis pa la/ snod dang bcud sbyor tshul gnyis las/ dang po ni/ snod kyi 'jig rten ni/ lha'i gzhal yas khang dang*/ lha dpa' bo gcig pa'i mngon rtogs la ni/ lha'i gdan gyis kyang sbyong bar byed cing*/ bcud sbyor tshul la/ bskyed chog gis skye gnas bzhi sbyor tshul dang*/ lha'i rnam pas dug gsum sbyong ba'o/ /dang po ni/ mngon byang lnga bskyed kyis drod gsher skyes sbyong ba dang*/ mkha' nang nas lha tshogs spro bas mngal skyes sbyong ba dang*/ 'od kyi gong bu las bzhengs pa dang*/ rdo rje cho ga gsum bskyed kyis sgong skyes sbyong*/ skad cig gis bskyed pa'i rnal 'byor gyis rdzus skyes sbyong ba'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ lha rnams zhi ba dang khro bo dang khro chags 'dres pa gsum du 'dus shing*/ chags pa'i rnam pas 'dod chags sbyong ba dang*/ shin tu zhi ba'i rnam pas gti mug sbyong*/ kha shin tu khro bo'i rnam pas zhe sdang sbyong*/ khro chags 'dres pa'i rnam pas dug gsum ka sbyong ba yin te/ de yang btsun mo'i 'khor gyi nang du 'dug pas 'dod chags sbyong*/ khro bo chen por bstan pas zhe sdang sbyong*/ mtshan dpe dang ldan pas gti mug sbyongs ba yin no/ /des na zhi khro phyogs re ba ni mi zab pa yin la/ khrau chags 'dres pa ni shin tu zab pa yin no/ /rdo rje gur las/

'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug dang*/ /nga rgyal ser sna'i skye bo rnams/ /bsdu phyir rang gi 'khor lo la/ /rdo rje'i gzugs ni du ma 'dzin/ /zhes so/ / gnyis pa ni/ gya nom lhar zhen gyi rnam rtog ni rdzogs rim gyis sbyong ste/ ji skad du/ rtsa rgyud las/ bskyed pa'i rim pa'i rnal 'byor gyi/ /brtul zhugs can gyis spros pa sgom/ /spros pa rmi lam ltar byas nas/ /spros pa nyid ni spros med byed/ /ces gsungs/ de yang bskyed rim gyi gnas skabs su/ stong pa nyid kyi lta ba dang 'dres pas gya nom lhar zhen gyi rnam rtog cung zad mgo mnon par byed mod kyi/ gya nom lhar zhen gyi rnam rtog phra mo rnams dpyis 'byin pa la rdzogs rim sgom dgos pa yin no/ /gnyis pa thob bya gnyis su nges pa'i phyir bskyed rdzogs gnyis su nges pa ni/ spyir bskyed rdzogs gnyis char gyis sku bzhi ye shes lnga 'grub par byed mod kyi/ gtso bo gzugs kyi sku 'grub pa'i don du bskyed pa'i rim pa sgom dgos pa yin te/ rdo rje gur las/ sangs rgyas nga rgyal rnal 'byor gyis/ /sangs rgyas nyid du nges par 'grub/ /ston pa sum cu rtsa gnyis mtshan/ /gtso bo dpe byad brgyad cur ldan/ /de ni thabs kyi gzugs can no/ /zhes so/ /chos kyi sku 'grub pa'i don du rdzogs pa'i rim pa sgom dgos pa yin te/ sum+bu ṭi las/ rang byung ngo bo 'di nyid ni/ /chos kyi sku ni rab tu grags/ /zhes so/ / gsum pa ngo bo rten dang brten pa yin pa'i phyir bskyed rdzogs gnyis su grangs nges pa ni/ rtsa rgyud las/ rdzogs pa'i rim pa'i rnal 'byor 'di/ /de yi bde ba bde chen brjod/ /rdzogs pa sgom pa med pa ste/ /bskyed pa yis ni ci zhig 'tshal/ /zhes rdzogs rim sgom pas chog gi /bskyed rim gyi ci zhig 'tshal zhes pa'i lan du/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ /e ma byang chub sems dpa' che/

/dad pa'i shugs kyis rab tu nyams/ /lus kyi dngos med gang las bde/ /bde ba smra bar mi nus so/ khyab dang khyab byed tshul gyis ni/ / bde bas 'gro ba khyab pa nyid/ /ji ltar me tog la gnas dri/ /me tog dngos med shes mi 'gyur/ /de bzhin gzugs sogs dngos med pas/ /bde ba nyid kyang dmigs mi 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pas me tog dang me tog gi dri ltar bskyed rim gyis sgrub pa'i lha sku lus kyi chos dang*/ rdzogs rim pa'i ye shes bde ba chen po sems kyi chos gnyis rten dang brten par gnas pa yin no/ /lnga pa go rim la/ 'phags skor ba rnams bskyed rim bstan nas rdzogs rim sgom par bzhed do/ /rim lnga las/ bskyed pa'i rim pa la gnas shing*/ /rdzogs pa'i rim pa 'dod rnams la/ /thabs ni rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis/ /skas kyi rim pa lta bur gsungs/ /zhes so/ /sems 'grel pa kha cig /bskyed rim brtan rung ma brtan rung lo bcu gnyis bsgoms nas gzod rdzogs rim bsgom par 'dod pa dang*/ slob dpon kha cig /bskyed rim la rdzogs rim gyis rgyas btab nas sgom par 'dod pa sogs mang du yong kyang rje ga ya dha ra'i bzhed pa/ rtsa rgyud las/ rim gnyis mnyam par gnas nas ni/ /zhes gsungs pa'i don gyis/ stan thog gcig tu thun stod la bskyed rim dang*/ thun smad la rdzogs rim sgom par brjod do/ / drug pa grol ba'i 'thad pa ni/ rigs sam rgyu yin pa'i phyir dang*/ thabs khyad par can gyis zin pa'i phyir dang*/ dag pa gsum gyi bdag nyid yin pa'i phyir grol bar 'thad do/ /dang po ni rtsa rgyud las/ rigs dang 'byung ba lnga rnams dang*/ /phung po lnga yi rang bzhin gyis/ /rigs dang bgrang bya 'di yis ni/ / rigs zhes mngon par brjod par bya/ /zhes phung po lnga sangs rgyas lnga'i rigs dang*/ nyon mongs pa lnga ye shes lnga'i rigs su gsungs pa dang*/ thams cad gsang ba'i rgyud las/

rgyu la 'bras bu'i rgyas btab cing*/ /'bras bu la yang rgyu rgyas gdab/ /zhes dang*/ rtsa rgyud las/ zhal phyag rnam pa'i gzugs can nyid/ /mchog tu bde ba gzugs med pa/ /de bzhin 'gro kun lhan cig skyes/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ sems kyi snang cha bzhin lag la sogs par snang ba ni rgyu yin la/ bskyed rim lha sku sgom pa'i rkyen gyis de'i rgyas 'gyur gyi rigs thob par 'gyur ba'i phyir gzugs kyi skur 'grub pa'i don du sgom pa 'thad la/ sems ky-i chos nyid bde stong gnyis su med pa'i ye shes su gnas pa ni rgyu yin zhing*/ rdzogs pa'i rim pa bde stong sgom pa'i rkyen gyis rgyas 'gyur gyi rigs 'thob par 'gyur ba'i phyir chos kyi sku 'grub par 'thad pa yin no/ / gnyis pa thabs khyad par can gyis zin pa'i phyir grol bar 'thad pa ni/ rim pa gnyis po thams cad gnyen por che ba bzhi'i bdag nyid can yin zhing*/ de yang rigs 'dra gnyen por che ba dang*/ bzlog pa gnyen por che ba dang*/ sgom pa gnyen por che ba dang*/ bsnan pa gnyen por che ba dang bzhi'o/ /dang po ni/ dper na khyi smyon gyi mche ba la sogs pa g.yo ba'i dug gis zin pa'i gnyen por btsan dug la sogs pa brtan pa'i dug 'gro ba ltar/ tha mal gyi rnam par rtog pa'i gnyen por lam gyi rnam rtog dang*/ nyon mongs pa'i gnyen por nyon mongs pa nyid lam du byed pa ste/ ji skad du/ dug gi dum bu gang nyid kyis/ /skye bo thams cad 'chi bar byed/ /dug gi de nyid shes pa des/ /dug gis dug ni 'bigs par byed/ /ces so/ / gnyis pa ni/ snod bcud tha mal pa la zhen pa'i gnyen por gzhal yas khang dang lha'i rnam pa bsgoms pa ste/ ji ltar rlung gis zin pa des/ /mon sran dre'u bza' ba sbyin/ /bzlog pa'i sman ni brtags pa las/ rlung gis rlung la bsnun par byed/ /gsum pa ni/ mgo bo gcig dang lag gnyis su zhen pa sogs kyis gnyen por dbu mang phyag mang du sgom tshul bstan te*/

ji ltar rna bar chu blugs pa/ /chu gzhan gyis ni dgug par bya/ /de bzhin dngos po'i rnam rtog kyang*/ /rnam pa nges par sbyang bar bya/ /zhes so/ /bzhi pa ni/ tha mal gyi 'dod chags kyi gnyen por dkyil 'khor 'khor lo bsgoms pa yin te/ ji ltar tshad pas tshig pa yang*/ /me yis yang ni gdung bar bya/ /de bzhin 'dod chags mes 'tshig pa/ /'dod chags me yis gdung bar bya/ /zhes so/ / thabs khyad par can de rnams bstan pas/ skye bo mi zad pa yi las/ gang dang gang gis 'ching gyur ba/ thabs dang bcas nas de nyid kyis/ /srid pa'i 'ching ba las grol gyur/ zhes so/ /gsum pa dag pa gsum gyi bdag nyid yin pa'i phyir grol ba'i 'thad pa ni/ ji skad du/ nges par dngos po thams cad kyi/ dag pa de bzhin nyid du brjod/ /phyi nas re re'i dbye ba yis/ /lha rnams kyis ni brjod par bya/ /zhes dang*/ rang rig bdag nyid dag pa nyid/ /dag pa gzhan gyis rnam grol min/ /zhes de bzhin nyid kyi dag pa/ lha so so'i dag pa/ rang rig pa'i dag pa ste gsum las/ spyir rim pa gnyis car la dag pa gsum ka tshang mod/ gtso bor chos thams cad gdod ma nas spros pa'i mtha' thams cad dang bral ba ni de bzhin nyid kyi dag par gnas la rgyu mtshan de'i phyir rtogs pa'i lta bas de rnams stong nyid du bsgoms pas grol bar 'thad/ phung khams skye mched kyi rang bzhin gdod ma nas lha so so'i dag par gnas la/ de'i phyir bskyed rim gyis de rnams la lha skur bsgoms pas grol bar 'thad/ sems nyid rang rig pa'i bde ba chen po rang rig pa'i dag par gnas la/ de'i phyir rdzogs pa'i rim pa bde stong gi ye shes bsgoms pas grol bar 'thad pa yin no/ /gnyis pa bskyed rim rgyas par bshad pa la/ bsgom pa po'i gang zagagang du sgom pa'i gnas/ gang gi tshe bsgom pa'i dus/ ji ltar sgom pa'i bsam pa/ bsgom bya dngos zhib mor bshad pa dang lnga'o/ /dang po ni rgyud rim gyis sbyang ba'am cig car ba'i gang zag gang yin yang*/

dbang bskur ba thob cing dam tshig dang sdom pa ma nyams pa las dang po'i gang zag go / gnyis pa ni/ ji skad du/ gnas ni bzang po nges par brtags/ /rang gi khyim du zhes gsungs pa ltar las dang po pas dang por rang gi khyim du sgom pa dang*/ brtan pa cung zad thob pas shing dang dur khrod la sogs par bsgoms ste/ shing gcig dang ni dur khrod dang*/ /ma mo'i khyim dang mtshan mo dang*/ /yang na dben pa'i bas mtha' ru/ /sgom pa bzang por nges par brtags/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /brtan pa chen po thob pas ni yul sum cu rtsa bdun rnams su sgom mo/ / gsum pa ni/ rtsa rgyud las/ mtshan dus su/ zhes gsungs pa ltar/ las dang po pas bskyed rim gyi lha sku la sems 'dzin pa'i dus gtso bor mtshan mo yin la/ lhag ma bzlas sgom la/ sogs pa bya ba'i dus la nges pa med do/ / brtan pa cung zad thob nas thun bzhi dang*/ brtan pa chen po thob nas gnas skabs thams cad du bsgoms pa yin te/ rdo rje gur las/ thun tshod bzhir ni byin rlabs pas/ /bsgoms na myur du 'grub par gyur/ /zhes dang*/ rtsa rgyud las/ bdag med rnal 'byor ldan pa'am/ /yang na he ru ka dpal brtson/ / zhes dang*/ gzhan pa'i sems kyis skad cig kyang*/ /gdug pa'i sems ni ma rig pas/ /dngos grub 'dod pa'i dngos grub phyir/ /mkhas pas 'bad pas mi gnas so/ /zhes gsungs so/ /

bzhi pa ni/ rtsa rgyud las/ bdag nyid grub pa'i sems kyis ni/ /rnal 'byor ma sgom shes rab can/ /yang na he ru ka dpal gzugs/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ lam dang lam ston pa po'i slob dpon la the tshom spangs nas/ nges par 'grub pa'i yid ches dang bcas nas sgom pa yin no/ /lnga pa la/ bsgom bya dkyil 'khor gyi rnam bzhag /sgom tshul mngon rtogs dngos kyi bshad pa/ bsgom 'bras sa lam gyi rnam bzhag dang gsum las/ dang po ni/ gong du bshad pa'i rtsa bshad cha mthun gyi rgyud rnams las dkyil 'khor gyi rnam bzhag mang du gsungs mod/ 'dir gur brtag sam gsum las bshad pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi rnam bzhag ni/ dngos bstan tshig gis zin pa dang*/ bla ma'i man ngag gis bkral ba gnyis/ dang po dngos ni/ brtag gnyis las/ sku kyai rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor/ gsung kyai rdo rje/ thugs kyai rdo rje'i ste thun mong gi he ru ka'i dkyil 'khor gsum/ snying po kyai rdo rje/ bdag med lha mo bco lnga'i dkyil 'khor te mchog gi dkyil 'khor gnyis te lnga'o/ / bshad pa'i rgyud rdo rje gur las ni/ mi bskyod pa kyai rdo rje lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor/ rnam par snang mdzad kyai rdo rje lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor/ rin chen 'byung ldan kyai rdo rje lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor/ 'od dpag med kyai rdo rje lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor/ don yod grub pa kyai rdo rje lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor te rigs rkyang gi dkyil 'khor lnga/ rigs bsdus la ni/ brgyad brgyad dbus su gnas pa'am/ / yang na nyi shu rtsa lnga'i bar/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar lha dgu ma lnga gcig tu bsdus pa'i dkyil 'khor dang*/ lha snga ma lnga gcig tu bsdus pa'i dkyil 'khor te/ rigs bsdus pa'i dkyil 'khor gnyis/ de dag la/ ji skad du/ sangs rgyas gtso bo gang nyid kyi/ /dkyil 'khor gtso bo gang 'gyur pa/ /de nyid kyis ni dkyil 'khor ro/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/

lha gtso bo lnga go 'pho ba'-i+i dbye bas rigs bsdus rgyas pa lnga bsdus pa lnga ste snying po kyai rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor bco lnga/ bdag med lha mo bcu gsum ma dang bco lnga ma ste dngos bstan tshig gis zin pa'i dkyil 'khor bcu bdun dang/ he ru ka gzhan gsum gyi sgrub thabs dngos su bshad pa la/ rgya bod kyi bla ma rnams kyi bzhed pas 'khor gyi lha tshogs sbyar bas dngos kyi dkyil 'khor nyi shur gsungs so/ / sam+bu ṭi las/ sku gsung thugs snying po'i he ru ka rnams la lha bcu bdun pa'i dkyil 'khor re re gsungs shing*/ rdo rje bdag med ma dang ye shes dbang phyug ma lha bcu gsum ma'i dkyil 'khor/ drag po gdan can lha bcu gsum ma'i dkyil 'khor/ rgyud 'di'i dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bor rdo rje dbyings te/ rdo rje sems dpa' lha so bdun gyi dkyil 'khor te/ dngos bstan gyi tshig gis zin pa'i dkyil 'khor brgyad do/ /'di'i bdag med ma ni/ slob dpon a bha yas lha nyi shu rtsa gsum du gsungs kyang*/ rang lugs kyi bla ma gong mas ni lha mo bco lngar bzhed do/ /gnyis pa la/ rgya bod kyi mkhas pa so so'i bzhed tshul mang du yod kyang 'dir ma smos la/ slob dpon rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug bir+wa pa'i man ngag gi lugs la/ rtsa rgyud kyi dngos bstan kyi dkyil 'khor lnga'i steng du/ rgyu rdo rje 'dzin pa gtso bor byas pa'i dkyil 'khor bsnan pas drug go /rdo rje gur las 'byung ba la/ snying po kyai rdo rje rigs bsdus kyi dkyil 'khor la rigs lnga'i dbye bas rigs bsdus rgyas pa lnga dang bsdus pa lnga 'byung ba bzhin du/ he ru ka gzhan gsum la rigs lnga'i dbye bas rigs bsdus rgyas pa lnga dang bsdus pa lnga ste bcu bcu 'byung bas/ rigs bsdus kyi dkyil 'khor bzhi bcu dang*/ dngos bstan snying po kyai rdo rje rigs rkyang*/ lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor la rigs lnga'i dbye bas rigs rkyang lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor lnga yod pa bzhin du/

he ru ka gzhan gsum la yang rigs lnga'i dbye bas rigs rkyang lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor lnga lnga 'byung bas nyi shu'o/ / de ltar yab he ru ka'i dkyil 'khor drug cu'i steng du bdag med ma'i dkyil 'khor gnyis te drug cu rtsa gnyis ljon shing las bshad pa ltar ram*/ yang gur rgyan ltar na/ sngar gyi dkyil 'khor de rnams kyi steng du rigs rkyang lha lnga'i/ dkyil 'khor nyi shu bsnan pas brgyad cu rtsa gnyis dang*/ de yang brgyad brgyad dbus su gnas pa'am/ /zhes pa'i skabs kyi dkyil 'khor la rigs rkyang dang rigs bsdus gnyis 'byung ba bzhin du/ yang na nyi shu rtsa lnga'i bar/ / zhes pa'i skabs kyi dkyil 'khor la yang rigs rkyang dang rigs bsdus kyi dbye ba don gyis thob pas/ yab he ru ka bzhi la rigs lnga'i dbye bas nyi shu la lha lnga'i dkyil 'khor re re ste nyi shu'o/ / rigs rkyang gi dkyil 'khor la/ rgyas pa nyi shu bsdus pa nyi shu/ rigs bsdus kyi dkyil 'khor la rgyas pa nyi shu bsdus pa nyi shu ste yab kyai rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor brgyad cu la/ sku gsung thugs snying po'i he ru ka bzhi la dkyil 'khor nyi shu nyi shu 'byung zhing*/ rigs lnga la dkyil 'khor bcu drug bcu drug yod/ 'dir nye bar mkho ba/ mi bskyod pa/ rdo rje can/ kyai rdo rje rnams ming gi rnam grangs dang*/ de bzhin gshegs pa/ sangs rgyas rtag pa phan pa rnams ming gi rnam grangs/ rin chen 'byung ldan/ rdo rje nyi ma/ gser gyi ri/ he ri'i rigs/ nam mkha' mdzod ces pa rnam grangs/ 'od dpag med/ pad+ma gar dbang*/ 'jig rten dbang phyug /rdo rje chos rnams rnam grangs dang*/ don yod grub pa/ rta yi rgyal po/ rdo rje rta mchog /bdun pa'i rgyal po/ lcags kyi rgyal po rnams rnam grangs so/ /sam+bu ṭi las/ dkyil 'khor dang po bdun gyi steng du rdo rje dbyings la rigs lnga'i lha gtso bo go 'phos pa'i dbye bas mchog sgrub pa'i dkyil 'khor lnga ste bcu gnyis so/

/de dag la he ru ka bzhi dang*/ bdag med ma ni kyai rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor dang/ ye shes dbang phyug ma ni rdo rje gdan bzhi'i dkyil 'khor dang drag po gdan can dang*/ rdo rje dbyings ni sangs rgyas mnyam sbyor dang mthun par bla ma gong ma rnams bzhed do/ / slob dpon a bha yā kā ra ni/ drag po gdan can ston pa'i tshig gis dur khrod la dgyes pa'i he ru ka dang*/ drag po gdan can gnyis ston par bzhed cing*/ de gnyis dang rdo rje dbyings ni 'khor lo sdom pa'i dkyil 'khor du bzhed do/ /de ltar yongs su dril bas kyai rdo rje rgyud gsum las dngos bstan mchog sgrub pa'i dkyil 'khor sum cu rtsa gsum dang*/ bla ma'i man ngag gis bkral bas brgya tham par 'gyur ro/ /las rgyas pa ni/ brtag gnyis las/ ku ru kul+le dang*/ lha mo bdun gyi lha sngags tsam gsungs shing*/ rdo rje gur las/ rdo rje sgrol ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi sgrub thabs dang*/ las tshogs rgyas par gsungs/ lhag ma las rgyas pa'i lha nyi shu rtsa bdun dang*/ las tshogs ci rigs pa dang bcas pa gsungs so/ /sam+bu ṭi las/ las rgyas pa'i lha nyi shu rtsa brgyad dang/ las tshogs shin tu rgyas par gsungs so/ /gnyis pa sgom tshul mngon rtogs kyi rnam bzhag la rje sa skya ba chen pos/ de la mngon rtogs rnam gnyis ste/ /mnyam par bzhag pa'i rnal 'byor dang*/ /mnyam par ma bzhag rnal 'byor ro/ /mnyam bzhag bskyed rdzogs rnam gnyis dang*/ /ma bzhag mnyam pa brgyad yin te/ /nyal dang ldang dang bzlas pa dang/ khrus dang kha zas gtor ma dang*/ /spyod lam rjes chags rnal 'byor brgyad/ /ces gsungs pa ltar bshad par bya ba la gnyis te/ mnyam par bzhag pa'i rnal 'byor dang*/ rjes spyod lam gyi rnal 'byor ro/ /dang po la 'dir bstan gtso bo bskyed rim rgyas par bshad pa dang/ zhar las byung ba rdzogs pa'i rim pa gnyis so/ /dang po la/ sngon 'gro'i cho ga dang*/

dngos gzhi'i bya ba gnyis so/ /dang po la/ thun mong gi sngon 'gro dang*/ thun mong ma yin pa'i sngon 'gro gnyis so/ /dang po ni/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed rdo rje sems dpa'i sgom bzlas rnams te/ 'di rnams mngon rtogs sgom pa re re sngon du byed dgos pas rgyud du rgya gzhung gis bshad pa med kyang*/ bla ma'i man ngag go /de la skyabs 'gro'i yul du gtso bo bla ma dang kyai rdo rje tha mi dad du byas pa'am/ yi dam kyi rigs bdag tu bla ma sgom pa gang bde byas la gzhan dkyus bzhin/ sems bskyed pa'i tshig ni rje btsun sa paṇa man gyis phyag len 'gro rnams bsgral 'dod bsam pa yis/ /zhes sogs mdzad do/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i bskyed chog ni/ rgyas pa rdo rje cho ga gsum las rdo rje sems dpa' he ru ka bskyed pa bsnyen pa/ de yi gnas gsum yig 'bru gsum gyis byin gyis rlobs pa nyer sgrub/ ye shes sems dpa' dgug gzhug sgrub pa/ dbang bskur nas rdo rje sems dpa' mi bskyod pas rgyas gdab pa sgrub chen te bsnyen sgrub yan lag bzhi'i sgo nas bskyed pa dang/ 'bring po gzhan 'dra ba las rigs bdag rang chas su yod pa dang*/ bsdus pa skad cig gis bskyed pa gsum po la sogs skabs dang sbyar nas gang bde ba zhig bya yi/ de gsum las gang rung gcig bzung nas 'di kho na bya dgos kyi gzhan gyis ma yin no zhes brjod par mi bya'o/ khyad par ljon shing las/ slaub dpon bi ru pa yi bzhed pa/ bsnyen sgrub yan lag bzhi ma tshang ba'i mngon par rtogs pa mchog thun mong gang la'ang mi bzhed do/ /zhes gsungs pa la brten nas skad cig gis bskyed pa'i rdo rje sems dpa'i bskyed chog mi 'thad do zhes zer ba mi 'thad de/ de ltar gsungs pa de ni mngon rtogs rang dbang can gyi dbang du byas pa yin gyi/ yan lag gi lha bskyed pa tsam la ma yin pa'i phyir/ gzhan du na rdo rje sems dpa' yan lag bzhi rdzogs su bskyed pa'i de'i yang rigs bdag yan lag bzhi rdzogs su bskyed dgos pa sogs thug med du 'gyur ba dang*/

mig tu gti mug rdo rje ma zhes sogs kyang yan lag bzhi rdzogs su bskyed dgos pa sogs ha cang thal bar 'gyur ro/ /rdo rje sems dpa' de nyid bla ma dang dbyer med du bsgoms nas sngags don rnams gsol ba 'debs pa'i tshig yin pa ltar yid la bsam zhing sngags 'dren no/ /de yang*/ oṃ ni bkra shis pa/ shrī badz+ra he ru ka sa ma ya ma nu pā la ya/ /zhes pa/ dpal rdo rje khrag 'thung dam tshig gis rjais su skyong*/ badz+ra he ru ka twe no pa tiṣ+ṭha/ zhes pa rdo rje khrag 'thung de nyid kyi nye bar gnas par mdzod/ ḍidho me bha wa/ zhes pa bdag la brtan par mdzad du gsol/ su to ṣ+yo me bha ba/ zhes pa/ bdag la shin tu dgyes par mdzod/ a nur rak+to me bha wa zhes pa/ bdag la rjes su chags par mdzod/ su poṣ+yo me bha wa/ zhes bdag la shin tu dgyes par mdzod/ sarba sid+dhi m+me pra yats+tsha/ zhes pa bdag la dngos grub thams cad rab tu stsol/ sarba karma su tsa me/ zhes pa las kun la yang bdag ni/ tsit+taṃ shrī yaṃ ku ru hūm̐/ zhes pa sems la dge legs su mdzod/ ha ha ha ha ho/ rnams ni spros pa'i tshig /bha ga wān badz+ra he ru/ zhes pa bcom ldan 'das rdo rje khrag 'thung*/ mā me muñtsa/ bdag la mi 'bral bar mdzad du gsol/ he ru ko bha wa/ zhes pa dpal he ru ka'i dngos po mahā sa ma ya sa twa āḥ zhes pas/ dam tshig sems dpa' chen po āḥ hūm̐ phaṭa ni bdud dang rnam rtog 'joms pa'o/ / gnyis pa thun mong ma yin pa'i sngon 'gro la/ mthun rkyen tshogs bsags pa/ 'gal rkyen bgegs 'joms pa'o/ /dang po la/ bsod nams kyi tshogs bsags pa dang*/ ye shes kyi tshogs bsags pa'o/ /dang po la/ yul mchog la bsod nams kyi tshogs bsags pa dang*/ yul dman pa la tshogs bsags pa'o/ /dang po la/ rten byin gyis brlabs pa dang/ tshogs zhing spyan drangs pa/ tshogs bsags dngos dang*/ gsum/ dang po ni/ tha mal gyi nga rgyal gyis mchod pa byas pa la yang bsod nams kyi tshogs che bar 'byung mod/

de lta bu'i bskal par mchod pa las kyang*/ dag pa'i snang bar bsgyur nas nyin zhag gcig gi bar du mchod pa bsod nams che bas/ lus tha mal du 'dzin pa'i rnam rtog 'joms pas bya ba'i phyir skad cig gis kyai rdo rjer sgom la/ sems tha mal du 'dzin pa dgag pa'i phyir snying khar pad nyi la hūṃ sngon po/ de'i zhabs kyu/ khog pa/ mgo bo/ zla tshes/ thig le dang lnga'o/ /ye shes lngar mos par bya'o/ /gnyis pa la/ gang nas spyan 'dren pa'i rang bzhin gyi gnas ni 'ga' zhig ltar/ 'og min stug po bkod pa la 'chad pa la yang mi 'gal mod/ 'dir chos kyi dbyings nyid yin pas 'gro 'ong gi rnam pa mi dgos shing*/ mdun gyi nam mkhar gsal btab pa kho nas chog la tshig ni/ de las 'od zer zhes sogs dkyus ltar ro/ /de yang bla ma dang yi dam ngo bo dbyer med yin par thams cad thun mod/ 'dir rnam pa tha dad pa ni bla ma rigs bdag gi tshul du sgom dgos pa yin no/ / gsum pa la phyag 'tshal ba/ mchod pa 'bul ba/ rgyun bshags/ sdom pa bzung ba dang bzhi/ dang po ni/ na mo gu ru bh+ya/ sogs so/ /gnyis pa ni/ nam mkhar sogs te/ mdun gyi nam mkhar rje btsun lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor bltas nas ni/ rdo rje skye ba ste rdo rje'i sa bon hūṃ las rgyan gyis brgyan pa'i lha mo spros te/ mchod tshul ni/ lha mo dkar mo ste go rī'i phyag tu ri dwags kyis mtshan ma zla ba'i brdas bstan pas byang chub kyi sems kyi gang ba'i de'i thod pa/ < bar 'dir lha mo chom rkun ma sogs bzhi'i bshad pa mi bzhugs/ mchan/ > ri khrod ma'i ro ste bcud len gyi gang ba'i thod pa/ bcud len gyi rdzas te mi sogs kyi 'gro ba gang la reg kyang tshe nyi ma dang mnyam pa sogs su 'gyur zhing rdo shing sogs la reg na gser la sogs pa'i rin po cher 'gyur ba'o/ /gdol pa mos cang te'u brdung ba dang*/ g.yungamo sku la 'khyud pa'i stangs kas mchod

pa'o/ /de yang lha mo dang po lngas nang mchod/ de nas gnyis kyis phyi mchod/ brgyad pas gsang ba'i mchod pa 'bul lo/ / gsum pa ni/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ /zhes pas skyabs 'gro mdor bstan/ rkang pa gnyis pas bshags pa/ gsum pas rjes su yi rang ba/ bzhi pas don dam byang sems 'dzin par dam bca' ba/ lnga pa dang drug pas skyabs 'gro dngos/ bdun pa dang brgyad pas smon sems/ de nas rkang pa gsum gyis 'jug sems/ rkang pa tha mas bsngo ba ste phyag 'tshal/ man chad bgrangs pas bdun pa'o/ /bzhi pa rigs lnga'i sdom bzung ni/ rgya gzhung rnams las gsal cha mi 'byung yang 'dir sbyar ba shin tu legs shing sbyor bar mdzad pa yin no/ / don ni/ sangs rgyas sras bcas dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma rnams dgongs su gsol nas/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba dus 'di nas ji srid byang chub ma thob kyi bar du ji ltar dus gsum mgon pos byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed pa de bdag gis bskyed nas nyes spyod sdom pa'i tshul khrims/ dge ba chos sdud kyi tshul khrims/ sems can don byed kyi tshul khrims gsum bzung ba dang/ rnam snang rigs kyi dam tshig la/ sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun gsum la skyabs su 'gro ba dang/ rdo rje'i rigs la dril bu phyag rgya slob dpon bzhi/ de yang kun rdzob brda'i rdo rje'i dril bu bris sku rnams dang*/ don dam pa bde ba chen po rdo rje/ rnam kun mchog ldan gyi stong nyid dril bu/ lus lha skur sgom pa phyag rgya'o/ /rin po che'i rigs la nyin mtshan dus drug tu zang zing mi 'jigs chos dang byams pa'i sbyin pa ste bzhi/ pad+ma'i rigs la phyi nang gsang ba'i chos 'dzin pa dang/ theg pa gsum gyi chos 'dzin pa gnyis/ don grub kyi dam tshig sdom pa thams cad dang ldan par 'dzin pa dang/ mchod pa'i las byas pa gnyis so/ /

rigs lnga spyi'i sdom pa la/ byang chub sems ni bla med mchog ces sogs te sdom pa de rnams sems can gyi don du bzung bar khas blangs pa dang*/ ma bsgral ba rnams bdag gis bsgral sogs so/ /gnyis pa yul dman pa la bsod nams kyis tshogs bsags pa ni/ tshad med pa bzhi sgom pa yin zhing*/ de la dang po gsum theg chen pa spyi dang mthun/ bzhi pa ni btang snyoms tshad med la sems can rnams la 'khod par gyur cig snyam du bsam mo/ /rtsa rgyud las/ dang po byams pa bsgoms pa ste/ /gnyis pa snying rje rnam bsgom zhing*/ / gsum pa dga' ba bsgom pa dang*/ /kun gyi mtha' la btang snyom mo/ /zhes bya/ de ltar bsod nams kyi tshogs bsags pas gzhi 'khor ba'i gnas skabs su skye ba phyi ma skye 'gyur gyi 'phen byed kyi las gsog pa dang mtshungs pa yin la/ sbyangs 'bras dang sbyar na bskal ba grangs med gsum du tshogs gsog pa dang mtshungs pa yin/ de gnyis dang mtshungs par sbyar ba'i dgos pa ni/ lam de ltar bsgoms pas 'khor ba'i chos rnams sbyang ba dang/ 'bras bu mngon du 'gyur ba'i rten 'brel khyad par can bsgrigs pa yin no/ /de ltar sgom pa'i gnas skabs kyi dgos pa ni/ lha rnams mchod pas mnyes shing rgyud byin gyis brlabs pa dang*/ des bar du gcod pa mi 'byung ba dang*/ tshegs chung ngu'i tshogs rgya chen po gsog pa dang*/ dngos gzhi'i ting nge 'dzin khyad par can skye ba'i rgyur 'gyur pa'o/ / gnyis pa ye shes kyi tshogs bsags pa ni/ rgyud dang sgrub thabs so so nas bshad pa ltar rnam thar bzhi dang*/ gsum dang*/ dag pa gsum dang*/ snang ba sems dang*/ sems stong par gtan la 'bebs pa stai/ de la tshul mang du gsungs kyang 'dir shu+u n+yā ta'i sngags don bsam par gcig pus chog la/ slob dpon 'ga' zhig ltar rigs pas dpyad pa sngon du gtong ba'ang mi 'gal mod/ mtha' gcig tu mi dgos pa ste/ rigs pa'i dpyad pa mi shes pa'i gang zag gis kyang bla mas bstan pa'i man ngag nyams su blangs pas don rtogs pa'i phyir/

dper na bu ram gyi 'byung khungs dang kha dog la sogs pa mi shes kyang ro myong ba bzhin no/ /rigs dpyad ma byas na mtshan nyid 'gog mi nus snyam na/ 'o na bskyed rim gyi lha sku sgom pa dang*/ rdzogs rim gyi rtsa rlung thig le yig 'bru sogs bsgaums nas kyang de la gcig tu bral sogs kyi dpyad pa dgos par 'gyur la/ de 'dra ni tshad ldan sus kyang ma bshad do/ /spyir dpyad pa sngon du gtong ba'i lugs la yang*/ dpyad pa btang zin pa'i don de la cir yang mi 'dzin par mnyam par 'jog pa yin gyi/ gang dag mnyam bzhag dngos gzhi'i skabs su yang*/ bdag med bden par med snyam pa'i 'dzin stangs kyi shugs drag po dgos zer ba dag ni/ chos 'di'i nges don zab mo la rgyab kyis phyogs pa'i gtam yin yang*/ de dag la ni mkhas pa snga ma rnams kyis dgag pa rgya cher brjod zin pa ltar shes par bya'o/ / stonganyid la yang*/ snang ba bkag pa dang ma bkag pa gnyis las/ 'dir ni snang ba bkag pa'i ci yang mi bsam pa nyid du mnyam par 'jog pa/ snang ba bkag na ye shes tshogs bsags 'di 'chi ba sbyong byed dam lam byed yin la/ 'chi ba'i dus su snang ba thams cad thim 'gro ba'i phyir/ rigs pas dpyad pa dgos pa rnams kyang*/ sbyang bya dang mi mthun no/ /de ltar na stong nyid la cir yang mi rtog par 'jog pa ste stong nyid ye shes rdo rje'i bdag nyid nga'o/ /zhes pa ltar stong nyid rigs pas myong byar byas pa ste/ de'i rjes thob tu sangs rgyas rnams kyi ye shes rdo rje'i bdag nyid nga'o zhes nga rgyal yang bya'o/ /de ltar ye shes kyi tshogs bsags pa ni/ gzhi 'khor ba'i chos la 'chi ba'i rnam pa dang mthun pas sbyor zhing/ 'bras bu'i chos la yang dag pa'i mtha' chos kyi sku mngon du byed pa'i rnam pa dang mthun pas lam du byed pa yin no/ /'dir ye shes tshogs bsags 'chi ba sbyong byed du bshad pa mi 'thad par 'dod pa ni/

mi g.yo bla med kyi rgyud las bsgoms pas rnam par dag pa brjod par bya ste dang por mchod pa ni bsod nams kyi tshogs de khyad par du 'phags pa'i las so/ / stong pa nyid ni ye shes kyi tshogs te khyad par du 'phags pa'i 'chi ba'o/ /dwangs ba'i lus ni bar srid kyi lus so/ /zhes gsungs pa dang dngos su 'gal/ kha cig gsung 'khor yan chad sngon 'gro'i chos la sbyang gzhi sbyong byed sbyor ba 'gogs pa ni/ rang nyid kyis kyang gsang 'dus ye shes zhabs lugs la ye shes tshogs bsags 'chi ba sbyong byed du bshad pa dang nang 'gal lo/ /gnyis pa bsrung ba'i 'khor lo bsgom pa la/ thun mong ba dang*/ thun mong ma yin pa gnyis/ 'di gnyis kyi khyad par dang po ni 'di'i rigs 'dra bla med kyi dkyil 'khor phal che ba zhig la thun mong du 'jug la/ gnyis pa 'di'i rigs 'dra ni 'di sogs dkyil 'khor khyad par can 'ga' zhig la yod kyi/ dkyil 'khor mtha' dag la 'jug pa ma yin pa'i don no/ / 'dir kyai rdo rje'i thun mong ma yin pa la 'chad pa mi 'thad de/ kyai rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor yin yang khro bcu'i bsrung 'khor med pa mang zhing*/ gsang ba 'dus pa dang*/ bdag med ma sogs la khro bcu de yod pa'i phyir/ thun mong gi bsrung 'khor bsgom tshul ni/ rtsa rgyud las/ rwa bas nyi ma sngon du rnam bsam te/ /nyin rer hūṃ byung sna tshogs rdo rje ste/ /rdo rje de nyid kyis ni rwa ba dang*/ /gur bcing ba yang rnam par sgom pa nyid/ /ces gsungs la/ de'i dngos bstan la nyi ma sna tshogs rdo rje rdo rje rwa ba gur de bzhi las ma bshad kyang*/ bla ma'i man ngag gis pad+ma rdo rje'i sa gzhi/ rwa ba bla bre me ri dang bcas pa spyi mthun du sbyar ba yin pas/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ ljang gu las sna tshogs pad+ma/ raṃ las nyi ma bsgom ste/ rab ces par yin pas mar rngaug rnam rwa las bskyed par bzhed/ rang lugs ni/ rgyud nas 'byung ba sa bon gyi yi ge 'di rnams la zla tshes thig le nā da dang bcas pa re bsnon pa man ngag yin pas raṃ las bskyed/

de'i dbus su hūṃ sngon po las sna tshogs rdo rje rwa nyi shu pa phyogs mdog la/ shar gyi dbus rwa dkar ba/ g.yas kyi rwa gnyis dkar ba dang sngo ba/ g.yon gyi rwa gnyis dmar ba dang ljang ba ste lnga/ lho'i dbus rwa ser/ g.yas kyi dkar ba dang sngo ba sogs rigs 'gre shing*/ dbyibs dbus rwa thad sor byas pa'i g.yas su rwa gnyis/ g.yon du rwa gnyis/ dbus kyang leb chags su yod par bsgom/ rwa bcu gnyis par byed na phyogs re la rwa gsum gsum ste bcu gnyis/ de la shar gyi rwa gsum dkar/ lho'i rwa gsum ser/ nub kyi rwa gsum dmar/ byang gi rwa gsum ljang ba'i mdog gi /rwa so sor kha dog mi gcig pa dgos shing 'di sgom bde'o/ /de la rwa nyi shu ni 'jig lta nyi shu 'joms pa dang*/ bcu gnyis ni ma dag pa'i rten 'brel yan lag bcu gnyis 'joms pa mtshon/ /hūṃ las 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phros pas rtse las sna tshogs rdo rje che chung dpag tu med pa 'phros pas 'og thams cad gang zhing*/ de rnams 'brel te shin tu brtan cing 'phang thub par bsam/ khor yug tu 'phros pas rdo rje 'greng bur gyur pa shin tu che ba/ de'i mtshams rnams de las chung ba/ de'i mtshams rdo rje phra mo nas dang rdul phran tsam gyis gang zhing 'brel te brtan pa steng du yang de lta bu'i gur bsam nas brtan byed du badz+ra rak+ṣa'i sngags lan gsum brjod do/ / thun mong ma yin pa'i bsrung 'khor ni/ rdo rje gur le'u bzhi pa nas khro bcu'i sgrub thabs dang sngags rnams gsungs/ le'u bcu gnyis pa nas bdag med ma yi mngon rtogs kyi sngon du khro bcu dang 'khor lo bsgom par gsungs shing*/ le'u bcu gnyis par rgyas par gsungs pa bzhin bsgoms te/ de yang ji skad du/ rdo rje gur gyi le'u bcu gnyis pa las/ nam mkha'i khams kyi dbus na gnas par/ /sna tshogs rdo rje bsgom par bya/ /hūṃ ni bcu gnyis sbyor ba yis/

khro bo bcu ni rim pas dgod/ /gshin rje mthar byed shes rab mthar/ /pad+ma mthar byed bgegs mthar byed/ / ḍā ki khro bo dbyug pa sngon/ /mi g.yo ba dang stobs chen dang*/ /gtsug gtor gdugs ni dkar po dang*/ /rdo rje zhabs 'og gnas pa ni/ /bdud rtsi sbyor bas thams cad du/ khro bo'i rnam par bsgom par bya/ /dpag tshad brgya ni khyab pa ru/ /bsam nas bgegs ni bskrad par bya/ / zhes gsungs/ bsgom tshul ni mngon rtogs bzhin la/ 'khor lo ni ga'u lta bu rtsibs brgyad pa ral gri so ltar rno ba phyir bstan pa/ steng 'og gi rtsibs gnyis mdung so sbugs stong lta bu/ bsrung ba bskyang bar mdzad na hūṃ mdzad dbus dang*/ gtsug gtor 'khor los bsgyur ba steng du byed/ de ltar byed na bzlas pa mi byed par mngon rtogs dngos gzhir 'jug pa'am/ bzlas pa byed par spro na yang khro bcu'i sngags so sor bzla yi uṣ+ṇi ṣa bzla bar mi mdzad/ bzlog pa gtso bor byed na/ gtso bo go 'pho ba'i gnad kyi gtsug gtor 'khor los bsgyur ba dbus dang*/ hūṃ mdzad steng du bsgom/ 'di ltar byed tshe/ gtso bo'i phyag mtshan g.yas kyi 'khor lo ni mtshon cha'i 'khor lo rtsibs rno ba/ phyi cha mu khyud med pa mdzum mo'i rtse la brgyus pa'o/ / gshin rje gshed kyi g.yas kyi tho ba ni rdo rje'i tho ba ste tho ba'i log dang phyogs so sor rdo rje rtse lnga pa re re mtshan pa/ shes rab mthar byed ni gzhan gyis mi thub pa yin la/ phyag mtshan be con ni rdo rje be con te 'chang zung phra zhing rtse sbom pa yas mar rdo rjes mtshan pa/ pad+ma mthar byed ni rta mgrin te pad+ma dmar mo 'dab brgyad yu ba dang bcas pa 'dzin pa/ bgegs mthar byed kyi rdo rje ni rdo rje sngon po rwa gdengs pa/ mi g.yo ba rdo rje'i yu ba byas pa'i ral gri/ 'dod rgyal lcags kyu/ dbyug sngon can gyi phyag mtshan ni/ gshin rje'i dbyug pa ste rtsa ba phra zhing rtse cung zad bkug pa stobs po ches rtse gsum/

hūṃ mdzad rdo rje dang dril bu rang gi phyag rgyas thugs kar 'dzin pa/ gnod mdzes kyi phyag mtshan gtun shing ni 'chang zung phra zhing rtse gnyis sbom pa'o/ /'khor lo'i steng phyogs kyi lha gtso bo'i dbu thad dam mdun ngos su nye ba tsam dang*/ 'og gi lha gtso bo'i rgyab la nye tsam du bsgom/ rgyu mtshan de'i phyir dkyil 'khor la 'bri dus steng gi khro bo shar sgo'i khro bo'i yang phyi rol dang*/ 'og gi khro bo nub sgo'i khro bo'i yang phyi rol tu 'bri ba yin/ de rnams kyi sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlabs/ ye shes spyan drangs/ chu bzhi sngon du 'gro ba'i nyer spyod kyis mchod/ gau ri ma la sogs pa'i sngags rgyas bstim/ dbang lha spyan drangs/ sngar ltar mchod nas dbang bskur rgyas gdab bzlas pa byed pa 'bring po dang*/ de'i skye mched kyang byin gyis brlabs/ mchod pa la yang dkar mo ri dwags sogs bcug /rgyas gdab grub nas mchod bstod byas te bzlas pa rgyas pa dang*/ 'bring po ltar las mchod pa la nyer spyod lnga tsam byas/ dbang lha'i mchod pa bzhag pa bsdus pa'o/ /bsrung 'khor gyi lha 'di rnams mngon rtogs kyi yan lag yin pas cho ga rgyas pa la gal chung 'bring bsdus gang rigs kyi chog /bsrung bzlog gi dmigs pa dkyus bzhin dang*/ bzlog pa la gnad lnga ste/ bsrung ba'i skabs su hūṃ mdzad dbus su yod pa de bzlog pa'i skabs steng du spos/ dbus su gtsug tor 'khor lo bsgyur ba bkod pa ste gtso bor go 'pho ba'i gnad dang ming sba ba'i skabs ming yig la bod skad la gang yin de'i ming thog ma bsam/ bsrung bya rnams kyi lus snying kha'i rdo rje'i nang du bsgoms mi bde na 'khor lo'i nang ngam rdo rje'i rwa ba'i nang du bsgoms pas rung*/ snying ga'i hūṃ las 'od phros lus rdo rje'i go bgos par bsam pa lus bsrung zhing ming sba ba'i gnad/ khro bo thams cad khros shing zhabs g.yas brkyang dang*/

phyogs mtshams rnams kyi khro bo rnams zhal phyir bsgyur/ steng 'og gnyis kyi khro bo yang dbus rang thad na med pas zhal phyir bsgyur pa don gyis thob ste lha'i rnam pa'i gnad/ bsrung ba'i 'khor lo g.yas su 'khor/ phyir bzlog skabs 'khor lo sngar g.yas su 'khor ba hūṃ zhes brjod pa dang mnyam du g.yon du 'khor/ 'khor lo'i rtsibs bar du sgrub bya'i las la grub pa'i rlung 'tshub ma dbye ba zla gam/ de'i steng du me 'bar bzhin pa'i gru gsum rang gi thugs ka nas 'phros pa'i pho nyas sgrub bya'i ske dang*/ rkang lag lcags sgrog gis bcings nas drangs la/ me rlung gi steng du spyi'u tshugs su 'dug par bsam la/ 'khor lo 'khor ba'i rtsibs rnams kyis bsgrub bya'i lus dum bur bcad/ mes bsregs/ ro ma rnams rlung gis khyer/ rnam par shes pa zhe sdang rnam par dag pa mi bskyod pa'i zhing du skyes par bsam la 'khor lo bskor ba'i gnad/ sngags bzla ba'i tshe uṣ+ṇi ṣa bzla ba sngags kyi gnad de lnga'o/ / sngags don ni/ na maḥs man+ta bud+dha nāṃ/ kun nas sangs rgyas la phyag 'tshal lo/ /na maḥs man+ta dharmā naṃ/ kun nas chos la phyag 'tshal lo/ /na maḥsaman+ta saṃ ghā nāṃ/ kun nas dge 'dun la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'di man chad kyis oṃ rnams ni phyag 'tshal lo/ si tā dkar po/ tra sa tre tshad skyobs oṃ bi ma la/ dri ma med pa oṃ shaṃ ka ra/ shaṃ zhi ba/ ka ra byed pa/ yang na bde bar byed pa/ pra t+yaṃ gi ra/ phyir bzlog pa ste/ pra t+ya phyir/ aṃ gi ra bzlog pa'o/ /badz+ra uṣ+ṇi ṣa tsakra warti/ rdo rje gtsug gtor 'khor lo bsgyur ba ste/ badz+ra rdo rje/ uṣ+ṇi ṣa gtsug gtor/ tsakra 'khor lo/ warti bsgyur ba'o/ /sarba yan+d+ra 'khrul 'khor thams cad/ maṇ+ḍa sngags/ mū la karma rtsa ba'i las/ ban+dha ni bcings pa/ tā ḍa naṃ/ brdegs pa/ kī la nāṃ dā/ phur bus btab kyang rung*/ ma ma gṛ te/ bdag la byed pa/ ye na ke na tsi taṃ/

gang ci yang rung ba/ kri taṃ byas pa de/ tata sar+wan tu/ byed par gyur pa thams cad/ tshin+dha tshin+dha chod gnyis/ bin+dha bin+dha phug gnyis/ tsi ri tsi ri phye mar gyis gnyis/ gi ri gi ri gnon gnyis/ ma ra ma ra sod gnyis/ hūṃ bcu dang phaṭa gsum/ de yang thog mar dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal nas/ badz+ra uṣ+ṇi ṣa tsakra warti zhes khro bo la bos pa/ sarba yan+d+ra zhes pa man chad bya ba'i yul nges bzung ba/ tshin+dha tshin+dha man chad ji ltar bya ba/ hūṃ phaṭa rnams ni khro bo rnams gsal 'debs so/ / thal mo gdab pa ni/ rdo rje gur las/ rdo rje tshir bas gdab par bya/ /zhes gsungs shing*/ dmigs pa/ rang nyid sku shin tu che ba'i phyag mthil gnyis nam mkha' dang sa gzhi ltar rgya rab tu cher ba'i mthil phan tshun du rdo rje leb mo che ba re/ de'i lte bar g.yas su nyi ma/ g.yon du zla ba/ de gnyis kyi bar du bsgrub bya bsam te thal mo gdab pas rdul phran tsam du brlag par bsam shing thal mo brdabs/ dmod mo'i skabs kyi rdzu 'phrul zhes pa ni de'i sgrub pa'i lha 'dre'i rdzu 'phrul yin la/ gzhan rnams rtogs sla'o/ /spyir khro bcu 'di la bsrung ba tsam dang*/ phyir bzlog gnyis las/ bsrung ba tsam gyis phyir bzlog mi 'grub cing*/ phyir bzlog gis gnyis ka 'grub pa yin no/ de ltar bsrungs ba'i 'khor lo bsgoms pas gzhi 'khor ba'i chos la gang du skye ba len par 'gyur ba'i bar du gcod pa sel bar mtshon cing*/ 'bras bu'i chos la mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya ba'i mdzad pa ston pa'i sngon rol du bdud kyi sde bcom pa mtshon pa yin no/ /

gnyis pa dngos gzhi'i bya ba la/ mngon par rtogs pa'i chings bshad pa dang*/ yan lag drug pa nyid rgyas par bshad pa'o/ /dang po la ting nge 'dzin gsum gyi/ gnas bzhi'i byang chub bzhi'i yan lag bzhi/ yan lag drug gis bcings pa'i ting nge 'dzin rnam gsum yod/ ting nge 'dzin gsum dang yan lag drug gnyis/ chings 'ching ba ni logs su bgrang mi dgos te/ gzhan du+u na yan lag bzhi dag gnas pa bzhi gnyis kas 'ching ba yang 'dren rig par 'gyur ro/ /rdzogs pa'i rnal 'byor gyi sgrub thabs zhes pa'ang rnal 'byor rdzogs 'phreng kho na'i lugs yin gyi/ spyi khyab tu 'jug pa'i bskyed rim gyi chings ma yin pas 'dir 'dren mi rigs so/ /dang po ting nge 'dzin gsum gyi chings ni/ dang po sbyor ba/ gnyis pa dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog /gsum pa las rgyal mchog gi ting nge 'dzin gyi bcings pa ste/ rdo rje rtse mo las/ dang po sbyor ba'i ting nge 'dzin mchog /rnal 'byor pas ni snyoms 'jug bya/ /de nas dkyil 'khor rgyal po mchog /de nas yang ni las rgyal lo/ /zhes gsungs/ de yang slob dpon nag po lugs kyi kyai rdo rje'i sgrub thabs lta bu yin te/ der rgyu 'bras kyi he ru ka'i bar du 'khor mi bskyod par rgyu rdo rje 'dzin pa zhu/ de glus bskul nas 'bras bu rdo rje 'dzin du bzhengs/ de'i sku gsung thugs skye mched byin gyis brlabs pa dang po sbyor ba/ mkha' gsang byin gyis brlabs nas 'khor gyi lha mo spro ba dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog dbang bskur mchod bstod sogs las rgyal mchog go / gnyis pa gnas pa bzhi'i chings ni/ gong bu'i gnas pa/ chu'i gnas pa/ gzugs kyi gnas pa/ gzugs med kyi gnas pa ste bzhi yin te/ gong bu chu dang gzugs gnas dang*/ /de bzhin gzugs las 'das pa'o/ /zhes gsungs/ dper na slob dpon mtsho skyes kyi lugs kyi sgrub thabs lta bu yin te/ rgyu rdo rje 'dzin pa dang 'khor bskyed pa yan chad gong bu/

rgyu? rdo rje 'dzin 'od du zhu ba sogs chu'i gnas pa/ 'bras bu'i rdor 'dzin du bzhengs pa man gyi bskyed rim gzugs/ rdzogs rim mar me'i rtse mo lta bus bsdus te 'od gsal du bcug pa ni gzugs las 'das pa'o/ / gsum pa/ byang chub bzhi'i chings ni/ dang po stongapa las byang chub pa/ gnyis pa sa bon las/ gsum pa gzugs brnyan rdzogs pa las/ bzhi pa yig 'bru dgod pa las byang chub pa'o/ /de yang rgyud las/ dang po stong pa byang chub sems/ /gnyis pa la ni sa bon bsdu/ /gsum pa la ni gzugs brnyan rdzogs/ /bzhi pa la ni yig 'bru dgod/ /ces gsungs so/ /sgrub thabs 'dis bcings pa'i mngon rtogs bka' babs bzhi'i nang na med kyang spyir ni mang du 'byung ngo*/ /de yang rgyu rdo rje 'dzin pa stong pa las byang chub pa/ 'khor gyi lha mo bskyed pa sa bon las byang chub pa/ 'bras bu rdor 'dzin dam ye bsre ba gzugs brnyan rdzogs pa/ yig 'bru dgod pa zhes pa yi ge'i skad dod ak+ṣa ra 'gyur ba med pa ste rigs bdag gis rgyas btab pas rigs 'gyur ba med pa'o/ / bzhi pa yan lag bzhi'i chings ni/ bsnyen pa/ nyer bsgrub/ sgrub pa/ sgrub chen te bzhi'o/ /de ni rtsa rgyud kyi lung drang ma thag pa de dang*/ gsang ba 'dus pa las/ bsnyen pa'i dam tshig sbyor ba dang*/ /nye bar sgrub pa 'byung ba dang*/ /sgrub pa'i don ni dam tshig dang*/ /grub pa chen po dag dang bzhi/ /zhes so/ /de ni kyai rdor man ngag lugs la slob dpon rin po ches sbyor bar mdzad pa lta bu yin te/ 'bras bu rdor 'dzin bskyed pa yan chad bsnyen pa/ skye mched dang sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlabs pa nyer sgrub/ ye shes sems dpa' spyan drangs nas bsre ba sgrub pa/ rgyas gdab sgrub chen no/ / lnga pa yan lag drug gi chings ni/ gzhal yas khang bskyed pa rnam par snang mdzad kyi yan lag sogs te 'og tu zhib par 'chad/ de ni kye rdo rje man ngag lugs dang*/

ḍom+bhi lugs lta bu'o/ / gnyis pa la lha'i rnal 'byor gyi rim pa dang*/ lha'i rnam pa la dmigs pa'o/ /dang po ni/ rdo rje gur las/ sangs rgyas gnas pa'i rdzogs pa dang*/ / rnam pa lnga po sgom pa dang*/ /kun tu bzang po'i rang bzhin can/ /rang gi lhag pa'i lhar sgrub dang*/ /dkyil 'khor rnams ni dgod pa dang*/ /mchod bstod bdud rtsi myang ba sogs/ /rnal 'byor yan lag drug tu 'dod/ /ces dang*/ slob dpon mi thub zla bas*/ pho brang sangs rgyas rnam snang mdzad/ /dbang ni mi bskyod de bzhin gshegs/ /bdud rtsi myang ba 'od dpag med/ /bstod pa rin chen 'byung ldan dpal/ /mchod pa don yod rang bzhin mchod/ /rjes chags rdo rje sems dpa' dngos/ /zhes pa ltar gzhal yas khang bskyed pa rnam par snang mdzad kyi yan lag /rjes chags rdo rje sems dpa'i yan lag dbang bskur ba mi bskyod pa'i yan lag /bdud rtsi myang ba 'od dpag med kyi yan lagamachod pa don yod grub pa'i yan lag /bstod pa rin chen 'byung ldan gyi yan lag ste drug las/ dang po gzhal yas khang bskyed pa rnam par snang mdzad kyi yan lag ni/ ji skad du/ rdo rje gur las/ sangs rgyas gnas bzhi bsgrubs nas ni/ /zhes pa ltar/ gzhal yas khang bskyed pa yin te/ gtsug tor 'khor los bsgyur ba'i nang du bsgoms kyang rung mod/ de zhu ba las bskyed kyang rung bas/ rang nyid gtsug tor 'khor los bsgyur ba 'od du zhu ba las/ gzhi'i yan lag e las chos kyi 'byung gnas sgom/ de'i nang du rgyu'i yan lag so so'i sa bon las 'byung bzhi rim brtsegs/ gzhal yas khang rnam par snang mdzad kyi ngo bo yin pas/ rnam snang gi sa bon bh+ruṃ dang phyag mtshan 'khor lo yin pas de bzhin sgom/ 'di kha dog dkar po byed pa'ang yod mod mi 'gal ba/ bla ma'i man ngag gis ser po'o/ /rkyen gyis yan lag ni/ bar srid kyi ngo bo oṃ dkar po/ āḥ dmar po/ hūṃ sngon po ste bar do'i lus ngag yid gsum/

skye ba len pa'i sred len gnyis mtshon pa'i hoḥ dmar po mgo sprad pa gnyis kyis bar du chud pa ste yi ge steng nas steng du brtsegs pa/ de rnams las de 'dra ba'i sems kyi snang ba cha gcig chad pa 'byung bzhi 'khor lo dang bcas pa la thim/ 'byung bzhi 'khor lo dang bcas pa yongs su gyur pa las gzhal yas khang bskyed do/ /de yang rtsa rgyud las/ nam mkha'i dbus su bha ga bsam/ /zhes pas ni chos byung*/ 'khor lo sa dang chu ni sngon/ /ji ltar rigs par byin za dang*/ /lha rnams kyis rlung tshad chen dang*/ /ji ltar sgom pa 'byung ba yang*/ /chos 'byung 'dus bskyed 'khor lo nyid/ /ces 'byung bzhi lugs ldog tu gsungs pa de bzhin sa ni mtsho skyes lugs sogs yin la/ rdo rje gur las/ lugs 'byung du gsungs pas/ 'di rtsa bshad sbrel de man ngag gis 'byung bzhi rim pa can du 'god pa yin/ kyai rdo rje'i sgrub thabs tshad ldan 'ga' zhig las bar do mtshon byed 'jog pa med cing*/ 'ga' zhig las yod kyang nā dā la sogs pa sgom pa yod la/ 'dir grub chen ḍom+bhi he ru ka'i dgongs don/ slob dpon mi thub pa zla bas sgrub thabs yan lag drug pa las/ hoḥ gnyis bar du gnas pa yi/ /sku gsung thugs kyi yi ge ste/ /'di ni bar ma'i sems can ming*/ /zhes yi ge lnga dgod pa gsang 'dus ye shes zhabs lugs dang mthun par mdzad pa yin no/ / yi ge lnga po de sbyang 'bras la sbyar na/ longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku gsung thugs dang dbyings dang ye shes mtshon/ sems kyi snang cha 'byung bzhi 'khor lo dang bcas pa la bsres pas gzhal yas khang lha sku'i ngo bor 'gyur zhing*/ de nyid rang gi sems snang du shes pa'i dgos pa yod do/ /sems can gy-i las kyi mthu las snod kyi 'jig rten chags pa dang*/ zhing sbyangs pas dag pa'i zhing khams 'grub pa bzhin du/ yi ge 'bru lnga'i rnam pa can gyi longs spyod rdzogs sku'i mthu las gzhal yas khang 'grub pa yin te/

sems kyi snang cha gcig bsres pa'i dag sbyor gyi phyogs gcig ni 'di yang yin no/ /chos 'byung gi sbyang bya skyes gnas kyi dbang du byas na ma'i mngal dang sgong skogs sogs mtshon/ 'byung bzhi ni ma dag pa'i 'byung bzhi'o/ /rnam byang la chos 'byung zur gsum smad kyi zur dang bzhis rnam par thar pa'i sgo bzhi ste chos kyi dbyings chos sku/ 'byung bzhi ni yum bzhi'o/ / de ltar na sbyang gzhi sbyong byed sbyor tshul dkyus ltar na phrugs gcig ni de tsam yin la/ gzhan yang gzhal yas khang gis lus sbyong ba dang*/ lha skus sems sbyong ba ltar na/ mngal du 'jug pa'i sngon 'gro'i rim pa dang bsdus nas 'byung bzhi lugs 'byung dang*/ mngal du gnas pa'i tshe 'byung ba bzhis phan btags pa ltar lugs ldog tu sgom par bya ba yin/ de ltar 'byung bzhi las lus 'grub pa dang mtshungs par de las gzhal yas khang 'grub pa'o/ /sems snang cha gcig bsre ba yang bar do'i rnam shes 'jug pa nyid yin pas sbyang gzhi sbyong byed mi 'dra ba gnyis 'byung ba yin no/ /de ltar sbyong tshul phyi ma 'di gnyis ni slob dpon bir+wa pa dang ḍom+bhi pa'i man ngag las mi 'byung yang*/ pham thing pa yab sras kyi man ngag las 'byung ba ltar bla ma rnams skabs 'dir yang 'chad kyin 'dug pa ltar bshad pa yin gsungs/ chos 'byung gi nang du gzhal yas khang bskyed pa yin yang chos 'byung de'i gzhal yas khang mi sgrib par bsgom dgos shing*/ gzhal yas khang ni gru bzhi pa rin po che'i rtsig pa lnga sbrags brtsigs pa'i dpangs cha phran lnga/ de'i steng nas phyir cung zad 'bur ba'i pha gu ser po dpangs cha phran gcig las bskor ba/ pha gu ni da lta spa'u zhes grags pa 'di ka yin pas mthun mtshams rnams rin po che'i spras pa/ de'i steng nas bre spungs kyis btegs pa/ de'i steng du gser gyi gdung leb phyi ma gser gyi ska rags bzhi'i phyi ngos su chu srin gyi kha nas 'byung ba'i drwa phyed 'phyang ba/

'di dang bre spungs bsdoms pa'i dpangs cha bran gnyis so/ /sgo nang g.yas g.yon gyi zur dang sgo'i bar thad du ka ba re re ste brgyad kyis btegs pa'i steng du rdo rje'i gdung zlum po/ de la phan tshun nas phyam btang ste thog phub pa/ gdung zlum gyi steng du rtsig pa zlum po/ pha gu bre spung rnams cha phra ba'i steng du gser gdung zlum po de'i phyi rol du ska rags las drwa phyed 'phyang ba gser gdung bzhi mig mang ris su bris pa la phyam btang ste thog phug pa de'i steng du rtsig pa/ pha gu bre phul drwa phyed sogs gru bzhir yod pa la dbus phyur bur gyur pa'i thog phub pa'i rtser rdo rje rin po che'i mtshan pa rtsig pa'i phyi rol du 'dod snam dmar po cha chen gcig gi rgya dang phyed kyi dpangs tshad can/ 'di la kha khyer zhes kyang bya/ kha khyer bzhi zhes 'byung ba 'dod snam sgo mdun la med pas na dum bu bzhi'o/ / phyogs bzhir sgo cha phran phyed dang lnga pa'i dpangs tshad can/ glo bur du cha chen gcig phyir bton pa sgo khyud/ de las 'phred du cha phran gcig sgo 'gram/ de las slar mdun du cha phran gcig sgo log /rta babs sgo mdun du byed pa ltar na/ rtsig pa'i dpangs la cha phran bzhi/ de'i steng du mun pa dpangs cha phran gcig gi bar bre spungs/ de'i steng thog phub pa'i steng du rta babs rim pa bzhi la cha phran re re/ de'i dbus su mthong khar glang rgyab mig gsum gyi gzugs btod pa'o/ /de'i steng du pad+ma la gnas pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo gser las grub pa rtsibs brgyad nas bcu gnyis stong sogs ci rig pa/ de'i g.yas g.yon du ri dwags dang kṛṣ+ṇa sa ra re re/ de'i steng du gdugs dkar po gser gyi yu ba can/ snam bu so so la rgyal mtshan 'phan/ gzhan yang gos dang 'phan sogs dang*/ dur khrod brgyad kyang dkyus bzhin no/ / gzhal yas khang gi nang lha snam shar dkar sogs phyogs mdog can 'phar ma gcig pa bya/

rgyud las/ 'phar ma gnyis dag skyon med pa/ /zhes pa/ bdag med ma'i skabs yin yang 'dir yang sbyar du rung ngo*/ /de'i dbus su sna tshogs pad+ma yu ba khru gang tsam dang bcas pa la/ 'dab ma rnams deng sang phyogs bzhi dmar ba/ me rlung gnyis ser ba/ dbang ldan sngo ba/ bden bral ljang ba byed kyin 'dug pa ltar byas kyang rung mod/ rje btsun gong ma rnams kyis phyogs rnams phyogs mdog /mtshams rnams mdzes tshon du gsungs pas de bzhin du bya/ de'i ze'u 'bru ge sar dang bcas pa'i dbus su nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor/ 'dab ma rnams la zla ba'o/ /de gnyis gang byas kyang rung*/ dbus kyi nyi ma'i steng du phung po'i bdud kyi ngo bo tshangs pa ser po/ nyon mongs pa dbang po dkar po/ 'chi bdag nye dbang sngon po/ lha'i bu'i bdud kyi ngo bo drag po nag po rnams brtsigs shing*/ lag cha med par thal mo sbyar zhing gdong gyen du phyogs pa'am bkram/ gdan zhabs ji ltar byed kyis stabs dang bstun/ dbus gdan gyi tshangs pa gzugs khams kyi tshangs pa/ dbang po ni brgya byin/ nye dbang ni khyab 'jug yin la drag po bdud sdig can/ shar gyi gdan gyi steng du 'dod khams kyi tshangs pa ser pa'o/ /lhor phyogs skyong bcu'i dbang po dkar po/ nub tu nye dbang sngon po/ byang du drag po nag po byang shar du gshin rje sngon po ni gshin rje chos rgyal/ shar lhor nor bdag ni rnam sras ser po/ lho nub tu srin po nag po ni phyogs skyong bcu'i nang tshan nub byang du thags bzang ris dud kha ni lha ma yin no/ /de rnams gdong gyen du phyogs pa'i gdan/ lha'i gdan bskyed pa yang gzhal yas khang sgom pa'i yan lag yin zhing*/ gzhal yas khang gdan bcas te rnams rang gi sems snang yin pas nga rgyal bzung ba ni/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad/ a nī la ya/ pho brang*/ badz+ra swa bhā wa rang bzhin gyi rdo rje/ āt+ma ko/

bdag nyid a haṃ nga'o zhes pa'o/ / sngags kyi nga rgyal ni rten gyi dkyil 'khor rang rig pa'i ye shes kyi ngo bor shes pa'i ched dang*/ yan lag drug gis mtshams shes pa'i ched kyang yin no/ / gnyis pa rjes su chags pa rdo rje sems dpa'i yan lag ni/ rdo rje gur las/ kun tu bzang po bden pa'i dngos/ /rnam pa lnga po bsgom bya ste/ /rang rang lhag lha'i sgrub thabs bya/ /zhes pa ltar/ dam tshig pa bskyed pa dang*/ ye shes pa gzhug pa gnyis las/ dang po la rgyu rdo rje 'dzin pa bskyed pa/ rgyu rdo rje 'dzin pa'i mdzad pa/ zhu ba glus bskul ba/ 'bras bu rdo rje 'dzin pa bzhengs pa/ 'od zer spro bsdus shing sbyong ba/ yi ge dgod cing byin gyis brlabs pa ste drug las/ dang po ni/ mngon byang lnga 'bras bu dang bcas pa yin zhing*/ de yang mngon byang dang po bzhi dang rgyu rdo rje 'dzin pa bzhengs bzhin ni mngon byang lnga pa yin la/ rgyu rdo rje 'dzin pa bzhengs zin pa ni 'bras bu'o/ /de la mngon byang lnga'i mngon par rtogs pa cung zad bshad pa la/ rgyud gzhung las ji ltar bshad tshul/ mngon byang gi dag byed bshad pa de'i 'phros don cung zad bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni/ rnal 'byor rgyud dang bla med kyi rgyud thams cad la thun mong du sbyar bar bya ba ni de nyid bsdus pa las gsungs shing*/ de yang sems so sor rtogs pa las mngon par byang chub pa/ byang chub kyi sems las mngon par byang chub pa/ brtan pa'i rdo rje las mngon par byang chub pa/ rdo rje'i bdag nyid las mngon par byang chub pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bdag nyid ji lta ba de lta bu las mngon par byang chub pa ste lnga'o/ /

gsang 'dus 'phags skor ba'i lugs la ni/ de bzhin nyid la mngon par byang chub pa/ zla ba las mngon par byang chub pa/ yi ge las mngon par byang chub pa/ mtshan ma las mngon par byang chub pa/ sku yongs su rdzogs pa las mngon par byang chub pa dang lngar gsungs pa la/ lhag ma bla med kyi rgyud sde phal cher las nyi zla kha sbyor dang*/ zla ba kha sbyor sogs khyad par phran tshegs ma gtogs don gyi spyi mthun pa yin/ 'dir rtsa rgyud brtag pa gnyis pa'i dgongs pa slob dpon rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug bir+wa pa'i bzhed pas bkral ba mngon par rtogs pa'i tshul bcu bzhi ste/ de rnams bsdu na/ skad cig gis bskyed pa sa bon rnams las bskyed pa/ ā li kā li la ltos pa'i mngon byang dang*/ de la ma ltos pa'i mngon byang bzhir 'du/ dang po ni cho ga shin tu bsdus pa ste go sla/ gnyis pa cung zad bsdus pa ni/ rgyud las/ de yi steng du zla ba yin/ /zla ba'i steng du sa bon nyid/ /phyi nas bdud las rgyal bas mnan/ /gnyis 'dus pa las bde chen po/ /zhes pas bstan/ de la dbye na/ yan lag bzhi drug gi dbye bas gnyis/ de re re la mkha' nang du thig le brgyad pas sa bon brgyad/ sa bon brgyad po phyir 'phros yongs su gyur pa las lha mo brgyad du gyur pa dang*/ gnyis pa ni sa bon brgyad po las yi ge brgyad du gyur pa las mkha' nang nyid du lha mor gyur nas phyir spro ba lha mo'i 'gros gnyis su phye bas bzhi/ sa bon 'gros ni/ rtsa rgyud las/ gaṃ tsaṃ baṃ ghaṃ paṃ shaṃ laṃ ṭaṃ/ 'di yis sa bon phyung ba dang*/ /zhes pas bstan/ lha mo'i 'gros ni rgyud las/ dkar mo dbang po'i phyogs phyung nas/ /shar gyi sgo ru yang dag gnas/ /zhes pa nas/ rlung gi mtshams su g.yung mo nyid/ /ces pa'i bar gyis bstan/ gsum pa ā li kā li la ltos pa'i mngon byang ni/ rgyud las/ ā li zla ba'i gzugs kyi gnas/ /kā li gzugs kyi snang byed do/

/ zla ba nyi ma 'dus pa las/ /dkar po la sogs rab tu grags zhes pas bstan/ de la dbye na shin tu rgyas pa yan lag bzhi pa la sbyar ba dang*/ rgyas pa yan lag drug pa la sbyar ba gnyis/ de re re la mnyam sbyor dang mi mnyam gnyis gnyis te/ yan lag bzhi pa'i gnyis po la/ mkha' nang nas lha mo brgyad kyi rgyu'i thig le brgyad po phyogs mtshams gyi nyi zla'am zla ba kha sbyor brgyad po'i bar du spros pa thig le bskyong ba thig le'i 'gros dang*/ mkha' nang nas yi ge brgyad nyi zla'am zla ba kha sbyor brgyad po'i bar du spro ba sa bon gyi 'gros te bzhi'o/ /yan lag drug pa'i gnyis la/ sa bon 'gros dang lha mo'i 'gros gnyis gnyis te bzhi/ de lta na ā li kā li la ltos pa'i tshul la yan lag bzhi drug gi dbye bas brgyad do/ /bzhi pa ni cho ga 'bring po ste/ ā li kā li la ma ltos pa dang*/ mi mnyam sbyor kho nar nges shing dbye na yan lag bzhi pa dang*/ drug pa gnyis/ yan lag bzhi pa la lha mo spro tshul thig le'i 'gros dang sa bon 'gros gnyis dang*/ drug pa la/ thig le 'gros dang sa bon 'gros te bzhi'o/ / skad cig las bskyed pa dang*/ sa bon las bskyed pa de bcu bzhi/ dag ldan du bco lnga zhes gsungs pa ltar na/ de'i steng du rdo rje cho ga gsum bskyed snon dgos kyi/ de 'dren pa mi 'thad par byed pa dag yod kyang*/ gzhan du na zlos skyon 'ba' zhig tu 'gyur ro/ / mnyam sbyor ni/ ā li kā li mnyam sbyor ba/ /zhes sogs kyis bstan/ mi mnyam sbyor ni/ de yi steng du zla ba yin/ /zhes sogs kyis bstan no/ /de rnams la slob dpon ḍom+bhi pa ni 'khrugs bsdebs nas mngon rtogs gcig la sbyor te/ 'di ltar mngon rtogs 'bring po yan lag drug pa ltar gtso bo yab yum mnyam sbyor gyi mngon bya lnga las bskyed/ 'khor rnams lha mo'i 'gros su bskyed pa kho na mdzad/ rgyud kyi don yang*/

de yi steng du zla ba yin/ /zhes sogs kyis ni zla nyi sogs bstan/ ā li zla ba'i gzugs kyi gnas/ /zhes sogs kyis zla nyi rgyud du bstan/ zla ba me long ye shes ldan/ /zhes sogs kyis de rnams kyi dag pa bstan/ gaṃ tsaṃ sogs dang*/ dkar mo dbang po'i phyogs phyung nas/ /zhes sogs gnyis kas kyang mngal du lhar bskyed nas spro ba bstan zhes gsungs so/ /de dag las skad cig gis bskyed pa dang sa bon las bskyed pa la ni/ rgyu rdo rje 'dzin pa dang*/ 'khor gyi lha mo dang*/ 'bras bu rdo rje 'dzin pa ste gnas skabs gsum char skad cig las bskyed pa dang*/ de rnams sa bon las bskyed pa'o/ /yan lag bzhi pa'i phyogs la/ rgyu rdo rje 'dzin pa dang 'khor gyi lha mo dang*/ 'bras bu rdo rje 'dzin pa gsum kha mngon byang lnga las bskyed pa dang*/ yan lag drug pa'i phyogs la/ rgyu rdo rje 'dzin pa mngon byang lnga las bskyed cing*/ 'khor gyi lha mo dang*/ 'bras bu rdo rje 'dzin pa sa bon las bskyed pa yin no/ / de ltar mngon par rtogs pa'i tshul bcu bzhi ni/ rjes chags rdo rje sems dpa'i yan lag gi gnas skabs las phye ba yin zhing*/ lhag ma gong 'og rnams la yan lag bzhi drug gis khyad par phran bu ma gtogs don la khyad par cher med do/ /de ltar zhib mor 'byed dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan de rnams sgom pa po yi gang zag skyes stobs kyi dbang po'i sgo nas rab kyi rab/ rab/ 'bring*/ tha ma/ mtha' ma'i mtha' ma ste lnga'o/ /de la mngon rtogs bsdus pa gnyis ni rab kyi rab dang*/ mtha' ma'i mtha' mas bsgom par bya ba yin te/ rim pa bzhin du de tsam bsgoms pas chog pa dang*/ de bas lhag pa bsgoms mi nus pa'i phyir/ mngon par rtogs pa 'bring po'i tshul bzhi ni rab dang mtha' mas bsgom par bya ba yin te/ rgyu mtshan snga ma de nyid dang*/ de tsam nges par bsgom dgos pa'i phyir/ mngon par rtogs pa rgyas pa brgyad ni gang zag 'bring pos bsgom par bya ba yin te/

de nyid sgom nus pa dang*/ de nges par bsgom yang dgos pa'i phyir/ de lta bas na gang zag gcig gis dbang po sbyang tshul gyi rim pas gang zag bzhir 'gyur pa dang*/ ā li kā li la ltos pa'i mngon byang dang*/ de la ma ltos pa'i mngon byang dang*/ sa bon las bskyed pa dang*/ skad cig gis bskyed pa ste mngon par rtogs pa bzhi sbyor la mtsho skyes kyi lugs yin pas 'di rnams dang rnam bzhag tha dad pa'i phyir gcig tu bsre bar mi bya'o/ /gnyis pa mngon byang gi dag byed bshad pa la/ sbyong byed bskyed rim gyi mngon byang lngar bshad pa/ sbyang bya 'khor ba'i skye ba bshad pa/ sbyang 'bras 'bras bu'i mngon byang bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni/ bshad ma thag pa'i bskyed chog gi rnam par gzhag pa de rnams la/ bskyed bya lha'i sgo nas gtso bo kho na mngon byang lnga las bskyed pa dang*/ gtso 'khor thams cad mngon byang lnga las bskyed pa gnyis so/ / gnyis pa ni brgyud pa 'di'i snga rabs pa rnams kyis gsung kho nar ltar na/ mngon byang gi zla bas rdzus skyes kyi sems kyi gsal cha dang*/ drod gsher skyes kyi gsher ba dang/ mngal skyes kyi pha'i khams rnams sbyong bar byed do/ /nyi mas ni rdzus skyes kyi gnas la sred pa dang*/ drod gsher skyes kyi drod dang*/ mngal skyes kyi ma'i khams rnams sbyong bar byed/ nyi zla gnyis car gyis kyang sgong skyes kyi sgo nga'i khyim dang bcud sbyor bar byed do/ /zhes pa de tsam zhig gsungs la/ mngon byang phyi ma gsum 'og tu 'chad pa dang 'dra'o/ /rang lugs kyi bla ma phyi ma rnams kyis bzhed pa ltar na/ de nyid skye gnas gzhan gsum la gtso bor mi sbyor zhing*/ mngal skyes kho na la gtso bor sbyor bar mdzad de/ de yang slob dpon gzhan gyi man ngag gis kha bskangs nas zhib mor 'chad pa yin no/ /de la yang dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du sangs rgyas kyi mtshan bzang so gnyis kyi ngo bo ā li phrag gnyis re re nas skar ma ltar dkar ba/

de yongs su gyur pa las zla ba/ de'i steng du dpe byad bzang po brgyad cu'i bdag nyid/ kā li ya ra la wa ḍa dha zhes pa dang bcas pa phrag gnyis mar me'i phreng ba ltar re re nas dmar ba las nyi ma/ de gnyis kyi bar du hūṃ las thod pa sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte bar hūṃ gis mtshan pa dang/ aṃ las gri gug sngo nag yu ba la aṃ gis mtshan pa yu ba gyen bstan/ de rnams gcig tu 'dres/ de las skad cig tu rgyu rdo rje 'dzin pa bskyed de/ de la ā li so gnyis ni sbyang bya lus la khu ba mtshon zhing*/ yar ngo'i tshes gcig nas bco dang de'i mtshan mo bcu drug ste/ de rnams la skyes pa'i dbang du byas nas byang sems rkang pa g.yas kyi mthe bong nas spyi bo'i bar du 'pho ste bcu drug /mar ngos tshes gcig nas gnam stong gi bar rkang pa g.yon pa'i mthe bong nas spyi bo'i bar du 'pho ste bcu drug /bsdoms pas so gnyis/ sbyang 'bras la mtshan so gnyis dang*/ me long lta bu'i ye shes yin te zla ba bsgoms nas sbyang 'bras der mos pa bya/ kā li'i ni rdul mtshon cing brgyad cur 'byed pa ni/ rdul de la sa chu me rlung nam mkha'i khams dang lnga yod cing*/ gang na gcig yod pa der thams cad kyang ngo*/ /zhes gsungs pas/ de re re 'byung ba bzhi bzhir phye bas nyi shu/ de re re la rten thig le lus kyi chos re re dang*/ brten pa bde ba sems kyi chos re re phye bas bzhi bcu/ de rnams kyang kun rdzob snang ba thabs kyi cha re re dang*/ rang bzhin stong pa don dam gyi cha re re phye bas brgyad cu'o/ /sbyang 'bras dpe byad brgyad cu dang mnyam nyid ye shes te/ de rnams nyi mar bsgoms nas sbyang 'bras de yin snyam du mos pa bya'o/ /sa bon dri za zhugs pa mtshon zhing*/ gnas skabs de ni dkar dmar sems gsum 'dres pa'i skabs mtshon/ de nyid las phyag mtshan du gyur pa ni/ mngal du yan lag dang nying lag rnams dod pa mtshon zhing*/

sbyang 'bras so sor rtog pa'i ye shes so/ /'dres pa ni mngal du grub pa'i phung khams skye mched rnams yongs su rdzogs te btsa' ba la nye bar mtshon zhing/ sbyang 'bras bya grub ye shes/ de las sku yongs su rdzogs pa ni mngal skyes kyi phyi rol du skyes pa dang/ 'bras bu chos dbyings ye shes mtshon te/ rgyud las/ zla ba me long ye shes ldan/ /bdun gyi bdun pa mnyam nyid ldan/ /rang lha'i sa bon phyag mtshan ni/ /so sor rtogs pa brjod par bya/ / thams cad gcig gyur nan tan nyid/ /rdzogs pa chos dbyings dag pa ste/ / mkhas pas cho ga gsungs pa yi/ /rnam pa lnga po sgom pa nyid/ /ces dang*/ mnyam sbyor gyi dbang du byas pa ni ā li las zla ba dkar po gru gsum ā lis mtshan pa dang*/ kā li las zla ba dmar po kā lis mtshan pa brtsegs pa/ de'i steng du hūṃ las rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa de la sa bon gyi yi ge mi bsgoms ste/ hūṃ phaṭa rnam pa 'dod mi bya/ /zhes pa'i don yin gsungs/ de las 'od zer 'phro 'dus 'dres pa las lha skur bzhengs pa ste/ ā li kā li mnyam sbyor ba/ /rdo rje sems dpa' nyid kyi gdan/ /yi ge las byung gong bu la/ /hūṃ phaṭa rnam pa'ang 'dod mi bya/ /zhes gsungs/ mtshon don ni zla ba dmar pos rak+ta mtshon cing*/ gzhan rnams mi mnyam sbyor dang 'dra'o/ / de thams cad kyang lam byed bzhi'i sgo nas nyams su blangs dgos shing*/ tshur de la dper mtshon na me long lta bu'i ye shes de rnams zla bar bsgoms pas rnam pa lam du byed pa/ de nyid la me long lta bu'i ye shes la sogs par mos pa byas pas lan gcig de thob par 'gyur bas mos pa lam du byed pa/ sangs rgyas la mnga' ba'i me long lta bu'i ye shes de nyid 'di yin no snyam du bsgoms pas 'bras bu lam du byed pa/ des bdag gi rgyu la tshogs gsog cing sgrib pa 'dag pas byin rlabs lam du byed pa'o/

/de dag kyang zhen pas zhugs na 'brel bas mi bslu ba'i lam mo/ / gsum pa 'bras bu'i mngon byang bshad pa la/ dngos dang*/ de nyid bskyed rim la sbyar ba'i tshul lo/ /dang po la mngon par byang chub par 'chad tshul dang/ de nyid kyi ngo bo bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni/ ji skad du/ rdo rje gur las/ rdo rje nyi ma nub pa na/ /sbyor ba kun tu brtsam par bya/ /skya rengs 'char ba'i dus su ni/ / sgom pa mchog ni 'grub par 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar te/ de yang mtshan mo zla ba'i 'od dang 'grogs pa dga' ba skad cig ma dang po dang*/ nyin mo nyi ma'i 'od dang 'grogs pa mchog dga' skad cig ma gnyis pa dang*/ nyi ma nub pa na mtshams kyi mun pas khyab pa khyad dga' skad cig ma gsum pa dang*/ tho rangs skya rengs 'char ba'i dus su lhan cig skye dga' skad cig ma bzhi pa rnams mngon du byas nas/ skad cig ma lnga pa la mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya ba yin no/ /de ltar phyi dbyibs kyi mngon byang ni pha rgyud nas gsungs pa dang thun mong ba yin la/ nang byang chub sems kyi bsgrod pa la ltos pa'i mngon byang ni/ 'tshang rgya kha ma'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams la/ longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku dkyil 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyis dbang bskur ba de'i tshe/ rgyun mtha'i snga logs su bum dbang dang*/ gsang dbang sngon du 'gro bas shes rab ye shes kyi dbang bskur bas ni/ rang snang gi ye shes kyi ngo bor gyur pa thabs kyi dkar cha byang chub kyi sems spyi bo nas gsang ba'i dbang du 'ong shing brtan par byas pas/ yas brtan gyi dga' ba bzhi'i mtshan nyid can gyi ye shes bskyed pa de mngon byang dang po yin la/ de lta bu'i dkar cha dang lhan cig rang snang gi rig ma'i dmar cha ye shes kyi ngo bor gyur pa gsang ba nas spyi bo'i gtsug tu brtan par byas pas mas brtan gyi dga' ba bzhi'i mtshan nyid can gyi ye shes skye ba ste mngon byang gnyis pa yin no/
